Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

As the Field Marketing Manager for Japan, you will report to Twilio's VP of Marketing, APJ, and own the end-to-end field marketing motion for one of our most strategically important growth markets in the region.

You will be responsible for designing and executing a brand-to-revenue GTM strategy that spans the full funnel, from building market presence and brand credibility through PR and executive engagement, through to driving pipeline creation, acceleration, and deal closure in close partnership with our Japan sales team.
This is a high-impact, high-autonomy role suited to an experienced field marketer who is equally comfortable shaping strategy and rolling up their sleeves to execute. You will have access to central regional resources, specialist agencies, and the APJ Demand Creation HUB to amplify your efforts, but you will be the primary marketing voice and driver for Japan.
The Opportunity
Japan is a market that rewards precision, nuance, and cultural intelligence. In this role, your impact will go far beyond campaign execution. You will have the opportunity to deeply understand the Japanese enterprise buying journey, build high-trust relationships with sales leadership and key partners, and apply your commercial acumen to directly connect marketing activity to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
You will lead the Japan field marketing function across the full Brand-to-Revenue spectrum: building brand awareness and thought leadership, generating and nurturing demand, accelerating opportunities through targeted pipeline programs, and partnering closely with SDRs and Account Executives to support deal progression through to close.

You will also be a critical link between the Japan GTM team and Twilio's regional and global marketing functions, ensuring Japan's needs are represented and its programs are built on the best available assets, data, and capabilities.
You are a creative and analytical thinker, a skilled collaborator, and an experienced operator who can manage multiple concurrent programs without losing sight of the commercial outcomes that matter.

Own and execute the Japan field marketing plan across the full GTM funnel: from PR and brand-building activities through to pipeline creation, acceleration, and late-stage deal support.
Design and deliver integrated marketing campaigns in partnership with the APJ Demand Creation HUB, spanning email, social, paid media, content syndication, digital advertising, and paid advertorial channels.
Lead executive engagement programs in Japan, including executive roundtables, CxO-level events, and account-based relationship marketing initiatives that reflect the trust-based nature of Japanese enterprise buying.
Develop and execute partner marketing programs in collaboration with key Japan channel and alliance partners, driving joint pipeline and co-selling opportunities.
Oversee PR and communications activities in Japan, working with regional PR resources to build Twilio's brand credibility and thought leadership in the market.
Plan and deliver a portfolio of demand generation programs including physical and digital events, webinars, outbound prospecting campaigns, account-based marketing (ABM) programs, and content-led nurture programs.
Leverage intent data and signal-based marketing tools (e.g. 6sense etc.) to prioritize target accounts, time campaigns effectively, and ensure marketing investment is focused on in-market buyers.
Work closely with the Japan SDR team to ensure strong lead handoff, campaign follow-up alignment, and ongoing feedback loops that improve lead quality and conversion rates.
Partner with Account Executives to support late-stage pipeline acceleration: including targeted account-level programs, bespoke content, and customer reference activities that support deal progression through to close.

Use AI-powered marketing tools to enhance productivity and campaign effectiveness: including AI-assisted content creation, campaign performance analysis, audience segmentation, and personalization at scale.
Analyze campaign, program, and tactic performance using CRM and BI tools, maintaining a regular reporting and communications cadence with key stakeholders on Japan field marketing results, learnings, and optimization actions.
Prioritize market and segment needs using data, identifying what is working and what is not in current demand creation plans, and adjusting strategy and investment accordingly.
Collaborate with Marketing Operations to manage and optimize marketing automation workflows, ensure accurate data capture, and maintain lead routing integrity within Marketo and Salesforce.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness through better targeting, improved processes, and smarter use of technology and automation.
Serve as the primary marketing business partner to the Japan sales organization: gathering field intelligence, communicating back to corporate and regional marketing, and ensuring the GTM plan reflects what the market needs.
Work cross-functionally with the APJ Demand Creation HUB, regional product marketing, and regional PR teams to ensure Japan is represented in regional and global program planning and roadmaps.
Manage third-party vendors, creative agencies, event production partners, and media partners to deliver programs on time, on budget, and on brand.
Contribute to web localization and technical marketing system input, always representing Japan customer and developer needs within the broader APJ marketing infrastructure.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.
The strongest enterprise and mid-market marketing doesn't lead with a product — it leads with the problem a buyer already has. A hospital administrator isn't looking for "Lyft Concierge"; they're looking to reduce missed appointments. An auto dealer principal isn't looking for a rideshare product; they're looking to keep loaner logistics from costing them revenue.
We are in the process of revising our go-to-market for Lyft Business to organize around these audiences and their transportation problems, with Concierge, Lyft Pass, Business Profiles, and our Business Travel products positioned as the answer to a clearly named pain point by customer profile.
We're hiring an Industry Marketing Manager to build that audience-first structure for our priority verticals, starting with Healthcare and Automotive , across both mid-market and enterprise segments. You'll own the vertical narrative and the content, demand generation strategy, and enablement that will drive marketing-attributable revenue.
The primary function of this role is to build and lead vertical-specific go-to-market (GTM) motions for our mid-market and Enterprise business — bringing together vertical-specific content, demand generation, and sales enablement into a coherent, audience-first strategy.

Own vertical strategy and integrated programs
Design and execute large, orchestrated tentpole programs for our priority verticals (no more than 2 per quarter) — multichannel activation spanning digital, live events, paid media, social, and press — that bring our value proposition and industry point of view to life for a defined buyer (e.g., hospital CFO, healthcare operations leader, dealer principal/service manager).
Build and maintain a thought leadership agenda for each prioritized vertical: original research, proof points, and points of view that establish Lyft as the transportation authority in that space.
Lead Healthcare as the highest-revenue priority, and scale the model to new verticals
Own the strategic objective for Healthcare: defend Lyft's market leadership in NEMT (Non-Emergency Medical Transportation) while identifying and building new growth avenues within the segment.
Treat Healthcare as the proof-of-concept for vertical GTM — once the content, demand gen, and enablement model is working there, codify what worked into a repeatable playbook.
Scale that playbook to other priority verticals (e.g., Automotive, Universities, Hospitality/Events) as "Scalable Growth" opportunities — each with its own buyer, core transportation problem, and proof points, but built on a shared, repeatable "ROI playbook" methodology (defined vertical narrative → targeted demand gen → sales enablement → measured pipeline impact).
Drive cross-functional alignment and partnership
Build a strong, trust-based partnership with Sales and Product leadership; represent vertical marketing's point of view in cross-functional and executive forums.
Produce vertical-specific content and proof points that support Sales conversations and strengthen our positioning with target buyers.
Partner with Sales on account-based marketing (ABM) for priority accounts, and support full-funnel marketing ownership: from vertical paid demand generation and lead qualification (MQL/SQL definitions) through to sales handoff.
Bring together marketing, sales, and product perspectives across mid-market and enterprise segments. This role is the connective force that pulls a multi-faceted go-to-market motion into a coherent, audience-first strategy.
Scale through agencies and partners
Manage relationships with marketing and creative agencies to scale program execution, from campaign development through multichannel activation.
Build and run co-marketing programs with industry and technology partners to extend reach and credibility within each vertical.
Ensure all vertical marketing programs comply with the relevant regulatory and marketing requirements of the industry (e.g., healthcare marketing/compliance considerations).
Measure and prioritize with data
Define success metrics for every program and report business impact against them: pipeline influenced, MQL/SQL conversion, program ROI.
Bring rigor and evidence-based prioritization to a growing portfolio of vertical initiatives, using internal analytics tools to establish accurate baselines and guide where to invest next.

7+ years (L5) in B2B/enterprise marketing, with meaningful experience in industry or vertical marketing, integrated campaigns, or product marketing for regulated or complex-sale industries.
A track record of designing and running large, multichannel tentpole programs (digital, event, paid, social, PR) that tie back to measurable pipeline or revenue impact.
Experience managing marketing or creative agencies to scale output beyond what an internal team can deliver alone.
Demonstrated success building and co-executing marketing programs with external industry partners.
Strong cross-functional relationship-building skills, with real experience developing a vertical or audience-first GTM motion using data and content.
Familiarity with marketing compliance considerations in a regulated industry (healthcare experience a strong plus).
Executive presence: able to represent marketing's point of view credibly in senior/steering-committee settings and help align cross-functional plans.
Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort building structure where it doesn't fully exist yet — you'll be one of the people bringing the vertical strategy together across mid-market and enterprise, not simply executing an established playbook.
Experience with marketing automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot) and demand gen operations.
Experience using AI to automate workflows and speed of programs to market.

Experience in mobility, transportation, healthcare, or automotive B2B marketing specifically.
Experience building ABM programs in partnership with enterprise sales teams.

At Sierra, we’re building a platform to enable every company in the world to build better, more human customer experiences with AI. We partner with industry leaders such SoftBank, Uber, Rivian, CLEAR, and Sutter Health. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.
We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and Family. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.
Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor . Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps.

Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

Build and scale Sierra's performance marketing function by defining and executing the strategy that turns paid spend into pipeline. Own paid search and paid social end-to-end, including channel strategy, campaign execution, and the systems needed to scale.
Own pipeline and budget performance, managing a quarterly pipeline target and multi-million-dollar advertising budget. Make data-driven investment decisions and use forecasting, attribution, and reporting to optimize efficiency and demonstrate ROI.
Lead strategy through execution, defining account and persona targeting, messaging, and competitive positioning while also building campaigns, optimizing bids, allocating budget, and developing high-performing ad copy and creative.
Drive a culture of rapid experimentation by continuously testing audiences, messaging, creative, channels, and campaign strategies. Quickly identify what works, double down on successful initiatives, and iterate away from underperforming tactics.
Leverage AI to multiply impact, automating meaningful aspects of the marketing workflow to increase speed, scale experimentation, and expand the team's reach beyond what a traditional performance marketing function could achieve.
You'll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Marketing/Revenue Ops, and Customer & Product Marketing to align on target accounts, messaging, campaigns, data, attribution, and pipeline performance, while reporting into marketing leadership with the autonomy to set strategy and the visibility to drive measurable business impact.

7–10 years of B2B performance marketing experience with deep, hands-on ownership of paid search and paid social, including expert-level proficiency across Google Ads, Microsoft/Bing Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and Meta/Facebook Ads.
Proven success owning pipeline and budget performance, managing multi-million-dollar quarterly ad budgets, maximizing ROAS, partnering closely with Sales in a sales-led motion, and using attribution, forecasting, and marketing operations to connect spend to pipeline and revenue.
Strong strategic and executional capabilities, with the ability to develop account and persona targeting, messaging, and competitive positioning while also executing campaign structure, platform optimization, bid strategy, budget allocation, copy, and creative.
A data-driven operator with a bias for experimentation, who treats every campaign as a learning opportunity, translates complex data into actionable insights, and continuously optimizes performance based on results.
A self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments, embraces ambiguity, is excited by AI and its applications to marketing, and is motivated by building scalable programs and processes from the ground up.
Even better...
Hands-on experience with modern GTM tooling, including Clay and data enrichment platforms, along with experience executing ABM strategies for high-ACV, named-account sales motions.
Experience marketing technical or AI products to sophisticated B2B buyers, with a strong point of view on measurement and attribution in a privacy-first, post-cookie world.
A relentless experimentation mindset, with a constant backlog of ideas to test and optimize, always looking for new ways to improve targeting, performance, and growth..

Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.
Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.
Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.
Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.
Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

Du kommunizierst fließend und sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch (mündlich wie schriftlich).
Du arbeitest strukturiert, ergebnisorientiert und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit im Team vor Ort.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 1 Tag Homeoffice pro Woche. Bei uns zählen Ergebnisse und du entscheidest, wie du deine Ziele am besten erreichst.

We're looking for a Staff Product Marketing Manager to join our PMM team during a pivotal period of growth.

This is a high-ownership role at the center of everything Cockroach Labs does: you'll own the go-to-market for a defined portfolio of product areas, serve as the go-to-market lead for our company rebrand — the biggest brand moment in our history — and act as a launch bench across one of the densest release calendars we've ever shipped, including major GA milestones across editions, deployment, and operations.
Your product portfolio anchors one of our most strategic stories — how CockroachDB runs, watches, and connects itself in production: Observability & AI-Assisted Insights (including our new autonomous monitoring agent), Workload Management, and Ecosystem & Platform Integration (change data capture and how CockroachDB plugs into the modern data stack).

Together these areas sit at the heart of CockroachDB's AI-operations narrative and its “fits your stack” story, and you'll shape how the market understands them.
Product Marketing at Cockroach Labs sits inside the Product organization within R&D, which means you're embedded in the product development lifecycle from the start: you'll attend product planning, know the roadmap two quarters out, and author the “so what” for every feature that ships in your areas. If you like working with R&D in the morning, Demand Generation mid-day, and Sales in the afternoon, we'd love to hear from you.
You Will Own
Positioning and messaging for your portfolio. Develop, test, and deliver compelling positioning and value propositions for your product areas, tuned to the needs of key personas — developers, platform engineers, architects, and enterprise buyers. The core skill of this role is translation: taking complex technical capabilities and expressing them in language a CIO acts on.
Rebrand go-to-market. Lead the cross-functional go-to-market program for the company rebrand: narrative, messaging migration, launch sequencing, field and customer communications, and enablement — coordinating across Product, Marketing, Sales, and Comms to land it on time and with impact.
Product launches and releases. Drive launch-grade execution for the releases in your areas and serve as a shared launch bench for marquee GA moments across the roadmap. Help install and run a standardized launch playbook used for every product release.
Content and bill of materials. Create high-impact collateral — product briefs, website copy, blogs, whitepapers, case studies, and sales assets — that communicates real customer value, not feature lists.
Sales enablement. Build training and enablement that Sales actually uses: where we win by vertical, use case, and persona; how to tell the cost and resilience story against Aurora, Oracle, and Spanner; and how to sell in business language rather than database terms.
Market and competitive intelligence. Analyze industry trends, customer needs, and the competitive landscape. Feed win/loss insight, product analytics, and field feedback back into positioning, roadmap conversations, and enablement priorities.
Cross-functional GTM collaboration. Operate as a trusted partner to Product Management, Education, Demand Generation, and Sales. Influence outcomes across teams you don't own, and build joint deliverables that make the whole go-to-market stronger.
The Expectations
In your first 30 days, you'll go deep on the product (create clusters, run workloads), your journeys, and our go-to-market strategy. You'll build relationships with the PMs and engineering leaders behind your areas, audit the existing positioning and content, and get hands-on with the rebrand program plan.
By 60 days, you'll have refined messaging for your portfolio, taken ownership of the rebrand go-to-market workstream, and built the launch plan for the next release cycle in your areas. You'll complete 200-level Cockroach University courses.
By 90 days, you'll be executing in full: launches shipping on your playbook, rebrand milestones on track, enablement delivered to Sales, and an operating rhythm established with Product, Demand Generation, Content, and AR/PR.
You Have
8+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years in enterprise software/SaaS product marketing with a proven record of launching products to market (we're hiring at the Senior or Staff level depending on experience)
Enterprise infrastructure or developer-tools experience: you've marketed deeply technical products to developers, architects, and CTOs/CIOs, and you hold your own in the room with technical buyers — ideally with exposure to the database, data infrastructure, or AI categories
Exceptional technical-to-business translation ability: you instinctively rewrite “geo-partitioned leaseholder rebalancing” as “your app is fast everywhere your customers are”
Launch leadership: you've run complex, cross-functional launches end to end — and ideally a rebrand, repositioning, or category-level messaging change
Strong writing chops: you produce unique, personable long-form content that technical audiences actually want to read
Analytical rigor: you use win/loss analysis, product analytics, and pipeline data to inform strategy, prove what's working, and kill what isn't
The ability to thoughtfully use LLMs to radically improve PMM effectiveness
A track record of operating cross-functionally with product, engineering, and sales as a trusted advisor — navigating ambiguity, integrating diverse perspectives, and driving measurable results without direct ownership of every outcome

Experience marketing against cloud-native default databases (Aurora, DynamoDB, Spanner) and overcoming “good enough + already on AWS” inertia
Experience positioning observability, AIOps, or AI-assisted products
Familiarity with data integration and streaming ecosystems (change data capture, Kafka, schema registries) and how enterprises evaluate “fits my stack”
Experience building or running competitive intelligence programs (battlecards, win/loss cadences, sales feedback loops)

Work with Sales and Customer Success to build feedback loops between market signals and product direction.
Influence roadmap prioritization based on competitive gaps and publisher feedback.

Bias toward execution. You move quickly, produce work, and iterate rather than waiting for perfect information.
Prior experience in a founding or lead PMM role where you built the function rather than inherited it.

Reporting into the VP of brand and communications, you’ll drive ownership of the WRITER brand, internal and external, from campaign strategy to the systems that make great brand work scalable. You’ll help shape how the world sees us, how our employees feel about us, how our product expresses us, and how AI makes all of that more powerful.

Brand strategy and campaigns - You’ll lead brand campaign strategy from idea through activation — not just the brief, but the conviction behind it. You’ll develop concepts worth executing, manage the work end-to-end, and hold the bar for what “on-brand” actually means.

You’ll ensure every campaign builds something cumulative: a brand that people recognize, trust, and root for. You’ll partner closely with product marketing on integrated go-to-market campaigns, ensuring brand and demand work in lockstep.
The full customer and employee journey - Great brands don’t live in one channel. You’ll activate WRITER’s brand across the customer journey, and bring the same intentionality to the employee experience. Onboarding, all-hands, internal comms: the brand lives there too, and you’ll make sure it shows up with the same quality and care.
AI-native brand operations - WRITER brings the power of agentic marketing to the world’s best brands — and we run on our own platform.

You’ll own WRITER’s internal WRITER instance as the operational backbone of our brand: encoding our voice, guidelines, and creative standards into brand skills that the entire company relies on to produce high-quality, on-brand work at scale.

You’ll build and maintain the skill library that makes WRITER employees faster, sharper, and more consistent — without losing what makes us distinctively us. You’ll partner with product and engineering to translate that front-line experience into product insights, acting as an in-house advisor to make WRITER stronger for brand leaders everywhere.
Brand in the product - WRITER’s biggest brand touchpoint is the product itself. You’ll work with product and design to ensure our brand identity is felt inside the platform: in the copy, the experience, the moments that tell customers they’re working with something built with genuine craft and conviction.
Agency management - You’ll be WRITER’s day-to-day lead for our brand agency — setting the brief, driving the relationship, and making sure partners deliver work that actually moves us forward, giving them a clear point of view to work from.
Measurement and brand intelligence - What doesn’t get measured doesn’t get protected. You’ll define and own the metrics that matter — brand awareness, perception, campaign performance, pipeline influence — and use those signals to continuously sharpen strategy. You’ll conduct ongoing competitive and market research to keep WRITER’s brand ahead of the conversation, not just part of it.
Brand Central: the system behind the brand - You’ll build and own WRITER’s brand repository, creating a single, scalable source of truth for assets, guidelines, templates, and toolkits. Working hand-in-hand with the creative team, you’ll turn our brand into something the whole company can activate confidently without compromising consistency. You’ll also champion brand adoption across the organization, running enablement that makes internal teams genuine brand ambassadors.

You’ve built brand systems that scale — asset libraries, guidelines, repositories, brand skills or AI-powered toolkits — that genuinely help teams create on-brand work instead of just paying lip service to the guidelines.
You’re fluent in brand metrics. You know how to measure what matters, connect brand performance to business outcomes, and use data to defend and evolve strategy.
You communicate with precision and confidence. You can write a sharp brief, present a campaign with conviction, and tell a stakeholder why brand investment matters without resorting to platitudes.
You operate with low ego and high standards. You know how to build shared ownership and bring people along, because brand only works when the whole company believes in it.

Your first goal is to understand the Apify platform, its products, its users, how they use it, and why they love it. The role sits across multiple teams. You'll work closely with the Partnership and Core Services Product teams.
You'll start by mapping the current state of partner marketing at Apify: what exists, what's missing, and where the biggest opportunities are. There's no polished playbook to inherit. Your first job is to audit, prioritize, and start building.

s.h: By the end of the first month, we expect you to
s.t:
Complete onboarding, meet key stakeholders, and audit what's already happening across partner marketing: campaigns, listings, MDF agreements, and events.
Present a prioritized view of gaps and quick wins.
Build and run a real Actor on the Apify platform - understand compute units, storage, and the developer experience firsthand.
Know where to find and interpret data on platform adoption, compute usage, storage usage, and API call volumes - so you can answer questions like: Which platform features are growing fastest? Where is adoption dropping off?

s.h: By the end of the first 3 months, we expect you to
s.t:
Have at least one joint GTM campaign live or in production with a Tier 1 partner.
Have all marketplace listings updated to current messaging and branding.
Have an MDF plan and tracking in place through H2 2026.

s.h: By the end of the first 6 months, we expect you to
s.t:
Have a functioning partner marketing calendar and ways-of-working framework.
Show measurable output: pipeline influenced, marketplace traffic, MDF utilization.
Inform 2027 planning with a clear view of what to scale and where to invest.

The Growth team drives user and revenue growth across ChatGPT’s consumer and business segments as well as other OpenAI products worldwide. We operate across the full funnel - from awareness and acquisition through activation, retention, and expansion - using a combination of global performance marketing, AI-powered workflows, in-product optimization, insights, experimentation, and creative ops engineering.

We are hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to turn product-led growth priorities into clear audience strategies, compelling cross-channel messaging, coordinated go-to-market programs, and drive measurable, incremental growth.
You will partner closely with Growth Product, Consumer Product Marketing, Lifecycle, Performance Marketing, Brand, Creative, Research, Data Science, and International Marketing to ensure that full-funnel campaigns and initiatives are supported and connected to Growth capabilities and maximize the performance of these campaigns.

Build the marketing layer across the Growth roadmap: acquisition, access, activation and resurrection, monetization, and the shared Growth Platform.
Translate product hypotheses into audience insights, positioning, messaging, launch briefs, lifecycle journeys, landing-page narratives, performance creative, and in-product education.
Maintain an integrated plan that connects the Growth product roadmap to the consumer product marketing calendar across lifecycle, performance, social, creators, partnerships, and brand moments.
Serve as the subject matter expert across all Growth levers, advising teams across the organization on the most effective ways to integrate Growth into their initiatives.
Partner with cross-functional teams to design and interrogate the user journey so we can align our external promises with in-product and owned-channel landing, access, onboarding, continuation, and conversion experiences.
Create audience and market playbooks for new users, high-value, or at-risk cohorts, including where acquisition headroom, access friction, weak Week 1 continuation, churn, or monetization gaps are greatest.
Turn campaign, lifecycle, research, and product data into clear readouts that improve both marketing execution and future product prioritization.
Use AI-enabled workflows to increase research, synthesis, briefing, and iteration speed while maintaining judgment, quality, and user trust.

s.h: You might thrive in this role if you have
s.t:
5+ years of experience in product marketing, growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, consumer marketing, or a related role; equivalent project experience is welcome.
Evidence that you can turn customer or market insight into clear positioning, messaging, and practical execution.
Experience supporting a launch, onboarding journey, lifecycle program, conversion initiative, or growth experiment and learning from the results.
Comfort working with funnels, cohorts, experiments, and metrics—and knowing when the data does not prove causality.
Strong cross-functional execution skills and the ability to keep owners, decisions, dependencies, and next steps clear.
Clear, concise writing and the judgment to adapt one strategic narrative across product surfaces and marketing channels.
A hands-on operating style: you can structure an ambiguous problem, produce the work, and ask for help at the right moments.
Curiosity about consumer behavior, empathy for different audiences, and a thoughtful approach to growth, quality, and trust; global or subscription experience is a plus.

At Supercell, we craft immersive game worlds that inspire millions. Now, we're looking for a Marketing Manager to bring our games to life across EMEA.
We are seeking a Senior Marketing Manager to join our International Marketing team and to drive regional marketing campaigns and marketing initiatives across the EMEA region. This role requires strong campaign execution, cross-functional collaboration, and in particular a deep understanding of the DACH cultural landscape.

The ideal candidate is an operator with exceptional marketing judgement, capable of turning strategy into outstanding regional execution while proactively identifying opportunities to improve campaigns and regional impact.
What You'll Be Doing
Own the end-to-end execution of Supercell marketing campaigns, activations, and initiatives across EMEA.
Translate regional marketing strategy into concrete, high-quality regional go-to-market plans.
Lead the delivery of campaigns across digital, social, influencer, and partnership channels.
Manage timelines, budgets, and scopes to ensure campaigns ship on time and at a high quality bar.
Partner closely with local agencies, game teams, marketing strategists, and creatives to ensure smooth execution.
Coordinate with creators, agencies, and external partners to deliver integrated campaigns.
Oversee production across non-owned channels, events, and activations, ensuring consistency and accuracy.
Track campaign performance and player response, sharing insights with stakeholders.
Continuously improve execution quality by applying learnings and raising the bar over time.
Capture learnings, identify execution improvements and proactively recommend ways to improve future campaigns.
What You Have
Strong experience executing marketing campaigns in EMEA and ideally DACH markets, France and the UK - preferably in gaming, entertainment, or consumer brands.
Deep understanding of DACH media, culture, and player behavior.
Hands-on experience across digital and social marketing, including influencer and creator collaborations.
Familiarity with broader media channels such as TV, CTV, audio, and out-of-home.
Proven ability to manage complex projects, timelines, and budgets.
Experience working with international teams across time zones.
Clear and concise communication skills with strong attention to detail.
A proactive, adaptable mindset and comfort working in a fast-moving environment.
Would Be Nice if You Also Have
Experience working on live games or live service products.
Familiarity with Supercell games or a strong interest in mobile and competitive gaming.
Experience executing campaigns across EMEA.
Where You'll Be
This is a remote role based in Berlin, Germany.
You'll work closely with teammates in Helsinki, London and partners across the region. This is a globally connected role, with travel expected to Helsinki on a regular basis with occasional international travel.
What Success Looks Like

· First months: You're confidently executing campaigns aligned with global strategy, building strong relationships across teams, and ensuring smooth delivery.

· 6–12 months: Your work is driving measurable impact across awareness, engagement, and player growth. Campaigns feel locally relevant and consistently meet a high quality bar.

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects.
Hey, You Might Love It Here!
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture . But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
You Are Not Your Job Title ™
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
Relocation? Yes!
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
Not Sure if You Should Apply?
Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

At AlixPartners, we tackle complex challenges by transforming insights into innovative solutions, delivering lasting value for businesses, their people, and the communities they serve. Our products are designed to drive meaningful impact, ensuring sustainable growth and success.

By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity of thoughts and experiences bring to our firm, and are committed to the perpetual enhancement of initiatives, policies, and practices.

We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees' work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person and remote working. This role follows a different cadence to traditional consulting or on-site client presence. It follows a traditional product development cadence, while being expected to engage our users in appropriate situations such as business conferences and in-person workshops.

As Product Marketing Manager at AlixPartners, your primary responsibility is to own and manage the marketing programs around the firm’s growing portfolio of technology products. These are typically used on client engagements, and a large part of the role is driving internal awareness, adoption, and engagement across practitioners and client-facing teams.
You will translate complex capabilities into clear value narratives, building internal and external marketing programs This role spans the full Platforms portfolio, with responsibility for raising awareness holistically across all products and initiatives, not just individual releases. You will work hand-in-hand with the Product Manager and cross-functional stakeholders to turn feature releases into awareness moments, and usage gaps into engagement campaigns.

Product Branding and Content Development.
Partner with Product Managers, industry and service lines, and the wider marketing team to define the market-facing identity of each product in the Platforms portfolio. Establish and maintain clear value propositions, positioning statements, and messaging frameworks aligned with the firm's wider brand proposition and visual identity standards.

Lead the productization process — translating product capabilities into market-ready narratives. Brief and direct creative teams on product naming, visual identity, and brand standards.
Drive the development of core go-to-market content, including digital assets and sales material, ensuring a cohesive product presence before and beyond any individual launch. Create high-quality product content including demos, feature walkthroughs, onboarding materials, and release announcements.

Concept, brief and direct agency/contractors to produce video content to a professional standard. Maintain and improve internal knowledge bases, wiki pages, and public-facing product pages to ensure content stays current and accurate.
Internal Product Promotion and Awareness Build and execute internal marketing campaigns that drive product visibility, feature adoption, and top-of-mind awareness across business units and geographies. Ensure consistent messaging across channels. This includes firm-wide awareness initiatives that promote the Platforms portfolio as a whole, beyond individual product launches.
Product Demos and Showcases Deliver live and recorded product demonstrations for internal stakeholders, new internal users, and leadership. Present new features in a way that connects directly to user needs and business outcomes.
Stakeholder Engagement Build relationships with key stakeholders across the firm. Understand their workflows, pain points, and communication preferences. Translate that knowledge into targeted campaigns that resonate with specific user groups.
Marketing Collaboration Serve as the primary bridge between the Platforms product team and the central marketing function, operating with a close dotted-line relationship to the marketing team. Co-develop campaigns, align on messaging, and coordinate on external and firm-wide product promotions. Ensure all firm-wide communications follow established marketing protocols and channel ownership.
Strategy and Playbook Development Develop a structured awareness and adoption strategy for the Platforms portfolio. Build repeatable playbooks that can be applied across products and scaled as the portfolio grows. Translate strategy into actionable plans with clear milestones and ownership.
Feedback Collection and PM Partnership Act as a structured channel for user feedback. Gather insights from campaigns, demos, and stakeholder conversations, and bring them back to the Product Manager as actionable input. Serve as a close partner to the PM throughout the product lifecycle.
Automation and Tooling Build and maintain marketing automation workflows using Power Automate or similar tools to scale communication efforts, manage campaign triggers, and reduce manual overhead.
Metrics and Performance Define and track engagement metrics tied to awareness and adoption goals. Report on campaign effectiveness and continuously refine approach based on data.
This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties, or responsibilities.
What you'll need
Minimum of 6 years of relevant Product Marketing or Product Management experience.
Proven track record of building and executing internal or Enterprise B2B marketing campaigns with measurable results.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English. Able to communicate complex product concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Comfortable presenting and demoing products to diverse audiences, including senior leadership.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working alongside Product and Engineering teams.
Analytical mindset with experience defining and tracking KPIs for awareness and adoption programs.
Demonstrated ability to build marketing strategies and repeatable playbooks in complex, multi-product environments.
Intellectual curiosity and a commitment to ongoing personal and professional development.
Experience building automation workflows using AI (Power Automate, Zapier, or equivalent tools - Nice to Have).
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
Plus: 2+ years of experience in a professional services or consulting firm environment.

Within Booking Holdings, an enhanced and more connected B2B business is being built within Booking Holdings consolidating the businesses of Booking.com, Priceline and Agoda into a single global division (“New B2B Business”)

Your center of gravity is deep 1:1 / 1:few ABM on your strategic accounts - that is the majority of your time and where the value is. Alongside it you carry a capped, automation-led 1:many (Lead Gen) responsibility across the tail of your archetype: templated, segment-level campaigns that open accounts and book first meetings for BD. The deep work comes first; the 1:many tier is deliberately bounded so it cannot crowd out the committee-level plays. This is not a high-volume MQL-factory role.

Research & target your accounts and form a point of view on which product leads and how the relationship expands.
Run a capped 1:many motion over your tail. Templated, segment-level Lead Gen campaigns (built with the shared Marketing Ops Specialist) to open accounts and book BD meetings - and spot when a warming account should graduate into your 1:few tier. Kept deliberately bounded.
Map the buying committee, design the account plays, and create & adapt bespoke assets for your strategic accounts.
Partner with BD/Sales; run and optimize campaigns in the marketing automation platform; own your measurement layer.
What you will need (required)
4+ years in B2B marketing, with 2+ years in ABM, strategic-account, or field marketing.
Account-research and buying-committee-mapping skill - you can build an account dossier and a stakeholder map and turn them into a plan.
Multi-channel campaign orchestration - multi-touch, multi-stakeholder campaigns (email, LinkedIn, events, direct).
Ability to sell a portfolio, not a single product - comfortable matching the right product to a buyer and articulating an expansion path.
Strong BD/Sales partnership instincts; comfortable working without direct authority.
CRM + MAP fluency - a major CRM (e.g., Salesforce) and a marketing automation platform (Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, HubSpot, or Marketo).
Data-literate - comfortable defining KPIs and reading dashboards. Strong writing and executive communication. Long-cycle patience and ownership.

Travel, travel-tech, fintech/payments, loyalty, marketplaces, or B2B2C / partnership-led experience.
Exposure to intent-data / ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase, ZoomInfo, Bombora). Event-based engagement (exec dinners, roundtables). ABM certification (ITSMA or equivalent).
Self-serve / PLG onboarding funnels, affiliate/partner-network programs (CJ), or SDR/BDR collaboration. SQL/BI comfort is a plus but not required.
How we will measure success
Primary (70%): buying-committee engagement depth, pipeline influenced, multi-product expansion, deal velocity, and BD-reported influence on strategic accounts. Secondary (30%): qualified leads/meetings generated from the capped 1:many tier and graduation of warming tail accounts into 1:few.

Own strategy across channels including paid media (Google, LinkedIn, Reddit, programmatic), events, media partnerships, email, SEO/AEO, and outbound prospecting support.
Partner very closely with ABM, automation & sales enablement functions to deliver pipeline
Serve as a key strategic partner between sales and marketing leadership, translating field insights and campaign data into program-level recommendations.
Establish and lead a structured testing agenda across the team, sharing insights that inform broader marketing strategy.
Partner with marketing operations to ensure accurate tracking, attribution, and reporting across regions.
Regularly report on regional and global program performance to marketing and sales leadership.

B2B Enterprise sales motion experience, in particular working on ABM campaigns that have taken accounts from net new to closed won. Experience with Named Account Lists and Look-Alike lists is highly desirable.
Proven track record delivering pipeline through integrated programs across multiple regions or markets (North America and EMEA strongly preferred).
Deep understanding of demand strategy across paid media, events, SEO/AEO, and outbound marketing support, particularly as it impacts all stages of the sales funnel.
Strong commercial mindset with a clear understanding of how marketing influences deal progression and revenue outcomes across a global funnel.

s.t:
Wir fördern Chancengleichheit und schätzen Vielfalt. Wir verpflichten uns, ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitende zu schaffen.
yfood wächst international: Obwohl Deutschland unsers „Home Base“ ist, haben wir mit unseren internationalen Märkten ein dynamisches und buntes Umfeld geschaffen, in dem viele spannende Themen auf Dich warten.
Agilität ist uns wichtig. Daher arbeiten wir in einem hybriden Arbeitsmodell und bieten dir die Möglichkeit mit Workation aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten.

Als Start-Up hat man oft mit Klischees zu kämpfen . Manche sind aber auch wahr. Daher gibt es bei uns natürlich auch einen Obstkorb, deinen gratis Koffein-Kick oder das stille Wässerchen.
Come as you are. Ob im Anzug oder Einhorn-Onesie. Einen Dresscode kennen wir nicht.

Jobbeschreibung
Hey!
Wir sind vly – ein innovatives FoodTech-Startup aus Berlin, das die Lebensmittelindustrie revolutioniert. Unser Ziel: Gesunde, pflanzliche Milchalternativen, die nicht nur dir guttun sondern auch unserem Planeten.

Nach jahrelanger Forschung haben wir Produkte entwickelt, die deutlich weniger Zucker und mehr Protein enthalten, mit Preisen ausgezeichnet wurden und deutschlandweit erhältlich sind – wie unsere Milchalternativen aus Erbsenprotein und den allerersten Joghurt aus Ackerbohnenprotein. Aber das soll erst der Anfang sein!

Neben der ständigen Verbesserung unserer Produkte ist natürlich unsere Sichtbarkeit im Handel mit der wichtigsten Treiber für die Zukunft von vly. Hier beginnt dein nächster Schritt bei vly...
Deine Mission: Als Trade Marketing Manager:in bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer Marke und dem Handel . Du sorgst dafür, dass vly maximale Aufmerksamkeit im Regal bekommt – durch überzeugende Argumente, aufmerksamkeitsstarke Materialien und aktivierende Maßnahmen, die unsere Produkte noch schneller aus dem Regal heraus verkaufen.

Du berichtest an unsere Head of Marketing, arbeitest aber auch sehr eng mit Sales, Brand und Design zusammen und bist dabei eine der Schlüsselpersonen, die das große Bild von der Brand bis zur Regalplatzierung versteht.

Du trägst zur Entwicklung unserer Trademarketing-Strategie für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz bei und bist für deren Umsetzung verantwortlich.
Du unterstützt unser KAM- und Field-Force-Team beim Entwickeln von überzeugenden Sell-in-Unterlagen und Category-Management-Argumenten für einschlägige LEH-Kunden.
Du planst und koordinierst POS-Maßnahmen: Displayaktionen, Zweitplatzierungen und In-Store-Aktivierungen (z.B. Gewinnspiele).
Du analysierst Marktdaten (Nielsen, GfK, interne Sell-out-Daten) und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.
Du entwickelst starke Trade Marketing Materialien (z.B. Sales Folder, Präsentationen, Wobbler) in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Brand, Design und Sales.
Du organisierst und standardisierst unseren Auftritt bei Trade Messen und Verkostungen in Supermärkten.
Du beobachtest den Wettbewerb sowie die Regalentwicklung und bringst proaktiv Impulse, die unsere Sichtbarkeit und den Impact am POS erhöhen.
Du bist das Verbindungsstück zwischen Marketing, KAM und Field Force mit dem Ziel, effektive Maßnahmen auf Kundenbedürfnisse zuzuschneiden.

Purpose: Es ist absolut essenziell, dass sich das Lebensmittelsystem zum Besseren verändert. Deine Rolle trägt direkt dazu bei, es gesünder und nachhaltiger zu machen.
Impact vom ersten Tag: Du baust Trade Marketing bei vly auf – keine fertige Struktur, die du übernimmst, sondern echte Ownership.
Echtes Startup Teamgefühl: Ein kreatives und motiviertes Team, das zusammenhält – inklusive regelmäßiger vly-Day- und Offsite-Events.
Teamlunch : Unser Highlight - jeden Tag frisch gekochtes Lunch von unserer eigenen vly-Köchin!
Mobilität und Company Fitness: Zuschuss sowohl zum BVG / Deutschland-Ticket sowie zu deiner USC Mitgliedschaft.
Moderne Ausstattung & Coaching: Wir statten dich mit Mac/Windows-Equipment aus und bieten individuelle Coaching-Möglichkeiten.
FoodTech-Community: Sei Teil einer wachsenden Bewegung, mit spannenden Events und Networking-Möglichkeiten.
vly-Flatrate: Genieße so viel vly, wie du willst!
Stellenanforderungen

Hands-on Erfahrung: Du hast 4+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Trade Marketing oder Category Management in einer FMCG-Brand oder im LEH-Umfeld.
Expertise: Du hast bereits Trade Marketing Konzepte eigenverantwortlich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Displayaktionen, Sonderplatzierungen und kreative Materialien sind für dich kein Neuland.
Netzwerk: Du hast ein Netzwerk von einschlägigen Herstellern von Trade Materialien und kennst die Produktionsprozesse vom Design-Briefing bis zum Versand.
Daten sind deine Grundlage: Du kannst Nielsen-Daten und interne Daten lesen, interpretieren und in überzeugende Storys für den Handel übersetzen.
Mindset: Du denkst unternehmerisch und packst an – du wartest nicht, bis jemand eine Vorlage für dich erstellt.
Struktur: Du bist strukturiert, verlässlich und behältst auch mit mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick.
Stakeholder: Du arbeitest gerne cross-funktional und kannst zwischen Sales, Marketing und externen Partnern vermitteln.
Verfügbarkeit: Du wohnst in Berlin und kannst regelmäßig (mind. 50% der wöchentlichen Zeit) im Büro sein.
Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprache-Level und sehr gutes Englisch.

Company Description
Workleap is a Montreal-based tech company, founded in 2006. We're builders at heart, we make simple products that actually matter to the people who use them.

We have two product lines: The Workleap Agent , our agentic HR platform that helps managers become better leaders, and ShareGate , the world's leading solution for Microsoft 365 migration and governance. More than 15,000 companies worldwide trust us to do exactly that. We're intentional about who joins us.

If you're the kind of person who gets excited by a hard problem and wants to help shape what comes next, there's a place for you here.

We're looking for a customer marketer who sees our existing customer base as our biggest growth opportunity and who wants to own the work of turning that into expansion, upsell, and retention. This role calls for a data-driven person who can rely on product and market signals to proactively drive our customer program.
You'll take the customers we already have, figure out how to get them more value from Workleap, and build and run the programs that deliver it. You'll own the channels, the messaging, and the results.
This is a hands-on role. You'll run initiatives from start to finish: a webinar, an ABM play, a campaign, an exclusive dinner, name it. This means you need to be just as happy, for instance, to gather signals with your team, draft emails, send your work via HubSpot, and review performance to optimize your next round. This is an A to Z role.

4+ years in customer marketing, product marketing, or a hybrid customer/PMM role in SaaS or tech;
Proven ability to translate positioning into messaging and marketing campaigns, tailored to specific audiences;
Track record of running marketing programs from conception to execution, shaping the idea, briefing creative, and shipping the work yourself when needed;
Comfort with data to segment audiences, spot where customers stall, and measure what your programs return;
Hands-on with HubSpot or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform for segmentation, workflows, and performance tracking;
Strong cross-functional program ownership, able to keep several initiatives moving at once;
Fluent with AI as a practitioner, using it to do more and better work while keeping the output specific and sharp, never generic;
Leading and owning customer marketing, setting direction for your own programs.
Most of this sounds like you? Apply.
What the job comes with
Base salary: 85K to 105K. This range reflects our Canada-wide compensation scale. Final offers may be adjusted based on the candidate's region to align with local market conditions.
Annual bonus program.
LTIP program, share in Workleap's long-term growth.
RRSP + Family health insurance + telemedicine + annual wellness budget.
Flexible vacation policy.
Remote work, with access to our Montreal office.
In-person gathering twice a year.
Claude access, for everyone.
What drives us
At Workleap, we build software that sits at the center of how people experience work, every day, at every level.
We move fast. Priorities shift, decisions get made with the information we have, and we iterate. If you thrive on intensity and ambiguity doesn't slow you down, you'll feel right at home.
We're builders. We do what it takes to move forward. AI is part of our toolkit. We use it to go faster and decide smarter, not to replace judgment.
If you want real impact and a place where your decisions matter, this is it.
How we hire
Transparency is how we hire — for you and for us.
Your journey starts with a recruiter conversation, followed by a virtual interview with the hiring manager and one additional interviewer. Next, you'll complete a take-home case study and meet potential teammates to discuss and collaborate on your work. If it's a match on both sides, we move to an offer. Some positions follow a slightly different path — your recruiter will walk you through it on the call if that's the case.
In the spirit of transparency: we use AI to support parts of the process, but every hiring decision remains firmly human.
We're committed to making this an inclusive and thoughtful experience for every candidate. We're looking forward to showing you that.
By applying, you confirm you've read and agree to our privacy policy .

The role of the Campaign Marketing Manager is to maximise the impact of marketing and PR assets and enable sales funnel growth.

Working in close partnership with both marketing and sales you will lead the strategic development and execution of all key account campaigns including social media channels, with a strategy that amplifies complementary campaigns and further leverages marketing and PR collateral to attract leads for sales, whilst also using PR tactics to amplify proprietary data and research findings.

The Campaign Marketing Manager will also act as a brand ‘gatekeeper’, ensuring that brand guidelines are followed in all external-facing communication..

s.t:
Educate and inform the sales team through regular attendance at forecasting meetings, providing insights into campaign performance, lead generation, and customer engagement.
Foster a collaborative working relationship between marketing and sales teams, facilitating alignment on goals, strategies, and tactics.
Work closely with sales stakeholders to develop account-based marketing plans aimed at achieving their targets, and generate high quality leads.

Lead the strategic development and execution of key account campaigns in collaboration with sales stakeholders, ensuring alignment with sales targets and objectives.
Develop comprehensive account-based marketing plans to drive engagement and conversions within target accounts.
Develop and execute strategies to deliver key performance indicators (KPIs), optimising campaign performance across all channels.
Utilise analytical reporting to evaluate campaign effectiveness and inform ongoing and future activities.

Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless integration of CRM initiatives with overall marketing campaigns and sales efforts.
Oversee the development of compelling campaign creative assets, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines, messaging, and audience preferences.

Design, plan, and execute complementary social media campaigns to amplify marketing collateral and increase brand visibility.
Develop strategies to leverage social media channels effectively, engaging target audiences and driving traffic to key campaign assets.

Drive growth across all M3 market research companies by developing comprehensive marketing campaigns that support their objectives and integrate seamlessly with existing initiatives.
Control and measure resources available for specific initiatives, allocating and prioritising resources to maximise return on investment (ROI).

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the US.

You are a builder: You do not just execute existing playbooks — you design new ones. You thrive when given a blank canvas and a clear outcome.
You love both the craft and the machinery: You care deeply about great marketing, and you are equally energized by making the systems behind it run better.

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to scale Decagon's paid social programs internationally, with an initial focus on EMEA. This role owns paid social spend end-to-end—LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, emerging platforms—and is responsible for standing up and scaling an EMEA motion. You'll partner closely with EMEA sales leadership to make sure spend allocation tracks where the deals actually are, not just where measurement is easiest.
This is a channel-owner role for someone who's spiked in paid social specifically and has managed large budgets where efficiency and allocation decisions really matter. While paid social is the core of the role, you'll also flex into adjacent demand gen work—ABM, landing pages, email—as EMEA-specific needs come up.
In this role, you will
Own paid social end-to-end: Run LinkedIn, Meta, X, and emerging platforms from creative brief through launch, optimization, and reporting. You're accountable for efficiency and output across the full paid social budget, not just execution.
Scale spend into EMEA: Stand up and grow a paid social motion in EMEA from its current early stage. Adapt targeting, creative, and budget pacing to local buying behavior, currencies, and compliance requirements (GDPR and beyond).
Align spend to sales opportunity: Partner with EMEA sales leadership to make sure budget allocation tracks where the actual pipeline opportunity is by market and segment, not just where measurement is easiest.
Build the attribution story: Own how paid social spend connects to pipeline and revenue by market and channel. Bring your own point of view on what's working, backed by data, not just activity metrics like CTR and CPL.
Test and systematize: Run structured experiments across creative, audiences, and channels, and turn what works into repeatable playbooks the rest of the team can use.
Flex into adjacent demand gen: Support EMEA-specific ABM, landing pages, and email work as needs come up, in partnership with the broader demand gen team.
Your background looks something like this
5+ years in performance marketing with a clear specialization in paid social (LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, TikTok, or similar) rather than search.
Managed paid social budgets at meaningful scale (six-figure+ monthly spend) and can speak to how you allocated across campaigns, audiences, and markets.
Have run or scaled paid social programs in EMEA specifically—different currencies, buying behaviors, compliance considerations (GDPR, etc.), and local nuances in creative and targeting.
Analytical and comfortable owning your own attribution story: connecting spend by market/channel to pipeline and revenue, not just CTR and CPL.
Used to working cross-functionally with regional sales teams to align spend with where the pipeline opportunity actually is.
Can flex beyond paid social into adjacent demand gen work (ABM, landing pages, email) when EMEA-specific needs call for it.
Thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, where you're expected to take ownership, move quickly, and learn as you go.
Even better if you have
Have experience with Clay or similar audience-building tools and are comfortable building and iterating on paid audiences
Have stood up a paid social program in a new region from scratch (rather than inheriting one already built).
Speak a European language relevant to key EMEA markets (UK, DACH, France, Benelux, Nordics).
Bring point of view on emerging paid social channels or formats worth testing in EMEA.

At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.
We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.
If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.
At Braze, Product Marketing sits at the center of how we bring our platform to market—shaping the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that connect what we build to the value our customers feel.

As part of our Product Marketing team, you'll own narratives and GTM for the strategic technology partnerships that extend what's possible on our platform.

This is a role for a builder and a storyteller: someone energized by turning complex offerings into clear, compelling go-to-market programs, and who thrives working shoulder-to-shoulder with teams across Product, Sales, Partnership, and Marketing to bring them to life.

You will translate Braze's strategic technology partnerships into differentiated messaging, joint go-to-market programs, and field-ready assets that ladder up to our core platform narrative.
This is an individual contributor role focused on strong PMM craft and cross-functional execution. You'll bring a clear understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, and you'll work closely with internal cross-functional teams including Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to take initiatives from messaging through to field readiness.
GTM Strategy & Messaging
Develop GTM strategy based on joint business plans for strategic technology partnerships in collaboration with partner leads
Own the messaging architecture for Braze's strategic technology partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers and data platforms), ensuring each partnership ladders up to our core platform narrative and customer engagement story
Translate platform integrations into clear, differentiated value propositions with defined customer use cases and competitive angles
Work with Core Product Marketing to ensure technology partners are reflected accurately in product launches, campaigns, and core messaging
GTM Execution & Enablement
Drive joint go-to-market and co-marketing programs with technology platform partners, coordinating timelines and deliverables across internal teams
Drive partner launch motions end-to-end: messaging, packaging, enablement materials, and field readiness
Build and deliver core assets and enablement that actually get used in the field
Track performance and adoption, and report results back to cross-functional stakeholders
Cross-Functional Execution
Work closely with Product, GTM Strategy, Sales, Marketing, and Partnership to align on priorities and execute against them
Partner with Sales and the field to support active deals, customer conversations, and positioning
What Success Looks Like

s.h: In your first year, success means
s.t:
A repeatable launch and enablement motion for technology platform partnerships, with integrations reflected consistently across launches, campaigns, and core messaging
Trusted, productive relationships across Product, Sales, Partners, Marketing, and Services—you're the person teams pull in early

A storyteller. You turn complex offerings and integrations into clear, differentiated narratives that resonate with buyers and the field alike
A builder. You're comfortable with ambiguity and energized by creating structure, frameworks, and repeatable motions where none existed
A collaborator. You're a sleeves-rolled-up, low-ego operator who brings cross-functional teams along and gets things shipped without direct authority
GTM-fluent. You understand how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners and how to execute them in a fast-moving, matrixed organization

s.h: What You Bring to the Team
s.t:
7–10+ years in product and/or partner marketing at a growing B2B technology company, with strong product marketing (PMM) craft at the core
A clear, practical understanding of how go-to-market strategies work with technology platform partners, including joint GTM programs, co-marketing motions, and integration launches
Strong PMM fundamentals: messaging frameworks, competitive positioning, narrative development, and the ability to translate complex offerings and integrations into clear, buyer-ready stories
Experience marketing technology platform partnerships (e.g., cloud hyperscalers, data platforms, and the broader SaaS/martech ecosystem)
Experience building sales and enablement content—solution briefs, battle cards, decks, playbooks—that gets adopted and used by the field
A proven ability to work closely with cross-functional teams and execute without direct authority, navigating a matrixed organization to get things shipped
Excellent communicator, comfortable presenting to internal stakeholders and partners

Experience in customer engagement, marketing technology, CDP, or adjacent data/SaaS categories

As Senior Event Marketing Manager at Databricks, you will report to the Director of Corporate Events and collaborate with global teams. You will lead field initiatives and sales enablement for major events like the Data + AI Summit and World Tour. Your focus will be delivering premium field experiences, activating Sales colleagues, refining workflows, and strengthening cross-functional alignment to scale these programs and their business impact.
Impact Statement
Within the first one to two years, success in this role will look like:
Flagship events such as Data + AI Summit and World Tour are consistently treated as strategic field growth engines, with clear motions that translate event engagement into high-quality opportunities and healthy pipeline for priority and strategic accounts.
Clear targeting frameworks (including quotas, eligibility to attend, and strategic account selection) are defined with sales leadership, so the right customers, partners, and reps are prioritized for each program.
Field teams have a simple, repeatable event playbook (pre-, during, and post-event) that is widely adopted, with strong participation in event campaigns and follow-up activities from sales, marketing, and partner teams.
Attendee and customer experiences across field-focused programs are cohesive and premium from invitation through post-event follow-up, resulting in stronger relationships with strategic accounts, partners, and executive stakeholders.
Event performance is transparently tracked through agreed-upon dashboards and reports built in partnership with analytics and operations, giving leaders clear visibility into attendance, engagement, and downstream revenue impact to inform future investment decisions.
Lead flow from events into sales systems is reliable and timely, with well-structured campaigns, lead routing, and MQL definitions that enable BDR/SDR teams to act quickly and consistently on event leads.
Incentive structures (such as SPIFFs and recognition programs) are thoughtfully used to drive meaningful field engagement with event motions, without creating unnecessary complexity for sales or operations.
Cross-functional programs such as executive forums, partner summits, product announcements, and training and certifications are integrated into a unified field event strategy, so that messaging, targeting, and experiences feel connected for customers and internal teams, and internal stakeholders see the program as well-run with clear goals, communications, and meeting cadences that reduce friction and allow them to focus on driving outcomes.
What we look for

s.h: To achieve the outcomes above, you bring
s.t:
Extensive experience leading complex B2B marketing events or event portfolios end-to-end, including ownership for business impact and not just execution.
Proven track record partnering closely with sales and field teams to design event strategies, plays, and enablement that drive measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes.
Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple workstreams, agencies, and stakeholders while maintaining clarity on goals, budgets, and timelines.
Deep comfort working with CRM, marketing, and analytics tools to define targets, interpret event performance, and make data-informed recommendations about where to focus and how to improve.
Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional teams, and represent the event strategy and results clearly.
A metrics-driven, test-and-learn mindset, continually looking for ways to improve attendee experience, field engagement, and event ROI through experimentation and refinement.
Ability to operate both strategically and tactically: setting the overall field event vision and frameworks while also diving into the details needed to ensure world-class execution.

Job Description We’re looking for a collaborative and analytical Product Marketing Manager to join the marketing team at Tailscale .

You will work closely with product, marketing, and revenue teams to identify customer needs, pain points, and articulate “Why Tailscale ?” and then turn these insights into actionable assets for us to go-to-market with.

This role might be perfect for you if you are familiar with PAM, networking infrastructure, or enterprise security needs, and can communicate technical features as easy-to-digest benefits. If you love highly cross-functional work and want to help a rapidly growing sales and revenue team succeed, read on.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a motivated individual who is comfortable working asynchronously, thrives in ambiguity and has a focus on getting it right, not being right. Key Responsibilities
Becoming the expert on our users and customers — who they are, what their pain points are, and what drives them to seek out solutions
Collaborating with sales, product and marketing teams to develop and refine product positioning, messaging, and effective content
Launching new products or features, managing cross-functional projects associated with that launch, and measuring revenue and pipeline generated
Creating sales collateral and enablement materials— slide decks, one-pagers, training sessions, customer case studies, webinars, etc.. This includes delegating and working with designers/web developers/content marketers as needed.
Performing competitive and market analysis to inform messaging and campaigns, and influence product strategy
Represent PMM at industry events by delivering demos and gathering firsthand customer and prospect insights to shape messaging and campaign strategy
Helping drive meaningful sales pipeline

At least 5+ years of experience in product marketing, working with sales teams, and sales enablement
A proven track record in marketing, product marketing, sales enablement, product management, or a related field with a minimum of 5+ years of direct experience
An affinity for complex, highly technical subjects
Experience managing interdependent, complex projects and keeping multiple work streams on track
An analytical and data-driven mindset with an enthusiasm for problem-solving and measuring the effectiveness of your work
The ability to quickly adapt and react to changing plans and ambiguity.
Excellent people skills - this role will interact with many cross-functional teams and the ability to communicate and negotiate effectively will be critical to the success of this role

Demand generation in ANZ and Southeast Asia isn't a smaller version of the US playbook - it's its own game.
