We're looking for a Demand Generation Manager who's energised by that complexity, not intimidated by it.
You'll own integrated campaign execution across the full funnel - SMB through enterprise - for Southeast Asia, working closely with our Head of Demand Generation APAC, to adapt global and regional campaign strategy for local relevance - and to flag when local reality means we should do something different altogether. You'll partner with Brand & Content, Creative Services, Field, BDR, Sales and Partnerships to make sure campaigns don't just run, but actually move pipeline in-region.
This is an individual contributor role. You won't have direct reports, but you'll need the judgement and stakeholder skills of someone who could.

None.
How You'll Make a Difference
Plan and execute integrated demand generation campaigns across Southeast Asia, spanning paid, organic, lifecycle, field and ABM
Localise and adapt global campaign frameworks for regional relevance - language, buyer behaviour, channel mix, and competitive context differ market to market, and campaigns need to reflect that
Partner with BDR, Sales, field, Partner Marketing and shared services team - Brand & Content, Creative Services, Lifecycle, Product Marketing - to align campaign timing and messaging with regional pipeline goals and account priorities
Work with Brand & Content and Product Marketing to identify where existing assets translate well regionally and where new, locally relevant content is needed
Manage campaign calendars, budgets, and vendor relationships across multiple markets and timezones
Track and report campaign performance by market and channel, with a clear point of view on what's working, what isn't, and why
Build and maintain a regional measurement view in partnership with Marketing Analytics, so decisions are grounded in data rather than assumption
Bring forward recommendations on where regional investment should shift based on results
Establish success criteria that inform resource planning, campaign flighting, and prioritisation across multiple stakeholders
Represent Southeast Asia's needs and constraints in global campaign planning, so strategy isn't built only from a US, EMEA or ANZ lens

5+ years in demand generation, integrated campaigns, or performance marketing, ideally with experience across Southeast Asia markets
Comfortable owning campaigns end-to-end, from planning through execution to reporting, without a large supporting team
Comfortable self-serving in a lean-resource environment - from copywriting, basic design, case study interviews, to event execution - are part of the job here, not someone else's
Experience managing media budgets - with or without agencies - across multiple markets in Asia, with a clear read on where spend is and isn't working

Introduction
Du willst nicht einfach Kampagnen abarbeiten sondern Marketing von Grund auf aufbauen? Du denkst in Systemen, hast ein Gespür für Zahlen und weißt gleichzeitig, wie man Botschaften formuliert, die ankommen?
Wir sind Omnora, eine B2B SaaS-Company aus Frankfurt. Wir helfen Unternehmen wie DB, AOK und ADAC dabei, ihr Wissen zu sichern, zu strukturieren und nutzbar zu machen - mit KI.
Als unser Marketing Manager bist du von Tag 1 an die treibende Kraft hinter unserem gesamten Marketing. Du steuerst Kampagnen über alle Kanäle hinweg, baust unsere Performance-Marketing-Infrastruktur auf und entwickelst Schritt für Schritt eine Struktur, aus der langfristig eine echte Marketingabteilung entsteht. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Management Team zusammen - ohne festgefahrene Prozesse, dafür mit echter Gestaltungsfreiheit.
Kurz gesagt: Du bist unser Founding Marketing Manager. Was du hier aufbaust, gehört dir.
What's in it for me
Founding-Role mit echter Ownership: Du baust nicht in einer Abteilung mit - du baust die Abteilung. Was du hier aufbaust, trägt langfristig deinen Fingerabdruck und bietet dir echte Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Marketing Lead.
Blitzschnelles Lernen: Du tauchst in alle Disziplinen ein - von Content über Performance bis Automation - und lernst in Monaten, wofür andere Jahre brauchen.
Gestaltungsfreiraum: Statt festgefahrener Prozesse erwartet dich maximaler Freiraum, Dinge auszuprobieren.
Kurze Wege, großer Einfluss: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und siehst, wie deine Arbeit das Unternehmen bewegt.
Hybrides Arbeiten: Was zählt, ist dein Beitrag - nicht wo du sitzt. Wir arbeiten hybrid aus Frankfurt mit flexiblen Home-Office-Möglichkeiten.
Der perfekte Einstiegszeitpunkt: Mit marktreifem Produkt und starken Referenzen stehen wir vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschritt - der ideale Moment, um einzusteigen und mitzugestalten.
How you can make an impact
Performance Marketing & Lead Generation: Du planst, steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen auf Google Ads und LinkedIn mit einem klaren Ziel: qualifizierte Leads für unser Sales-Team. CPL, ROAS und Pipeline-Contribution sind deine Währung - nicht nice-to-haves, sondern tägliche Steuerungsgrößen.
Account-Based Marketing: Du entwickelst ABM-Kampagnen, die gezielt Enterprise-Accounts in der DACH-Region ansprechen - mit den richtigen Botschaften, zur richtigen Zeit, auf den richtigen Kanälen.
Omni-Channel Orchestrierung: Du steuerst alle Marketingkanäle zusammen - Paid, Organic, Content, Email - und sorgst dafür, dass sie als System funktionieren statt als Einzelmaßnahmen nebeneinander zu laufen.
Content & Kreation: Du entwickelst Formate und Inhalte, die bei unseren Zielgruppen ankommen, und testest kontinuierlich, was wirklich performt - datenbasiert statt Bauchgefühl.
Marketing-Infrastruktur: Du baust eine skalierbare Infrastruktur auf - von HubSpot-Automation über Lead-Tracking bis hin zu verlässlichem Reporting.
KI & Automatisierung: Du nutzt aktiv KI-Tools, um Prozesse zu automatisieren - von der Content-Produktion bis hin zu personalisierten Kampagnen.
Agentur-Steuerung: Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Marketing-Agentur, briefst Kampagnen, gibst Feedback und stellst sicher, dass Ergebnisse geliefert werden.
Sales-Marketing-Alignment: Du bist die aktive Schnittstelle zum Vertrieb und stellst sicher, dass Leads nicht nur generiert, sondern auch konvertiert werden.
Skills to be successful
Erste echte Berufserfahrung: Du bringst 1-3 Jahre Erfahrung im Marketing mit - idealerweise im B2B SaaS-, Tech- oder Startup-Umfeld. Du hast Kampagnen nicht nur betreut, sondern eigenverantwortlich gesteuert und bist damit auch mal auf die Nase gefallen. Beides ist wertvoll.

We're hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to join our Product and Lifecycle Marketing team. In this role, you'll design and optimize lifecycle programs that engage, retain, and grow members across their entire journey with Chime—from top of funnel through long-term retention—with a clear focus on driving growth, revenue, and member lifetime value (LTV).
This is a role for a holistic, business-minded marketer rather than a single-channel specialist.

You'll think in terms of segments, experiments, and outcomes: building targeted campaigns across the channels we own—push, in-app, and out-of-app (email, SMS)—while connecting those touchpoints with the broader, non-owned channels that shape the member experience.

You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams to turn data into segmentation, automation, and personalization strategies that move the business.
This is a role with department-level impact: you'll own diverse projects, exercise significant independent judgment, and influence how members experience Chime across the full lifecycle.
If you're creative, dedicated, and love working in a fast-paced environment alongside passionate colleagues, we want to meet you.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $139,000 and up to $181,000. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
Own full-funnel lifecycle strategy—from top of funnel through activation and long-term retention—building targeted campaigns that drive growth, revenue, and member LTV.
Define segments and translate them into targeted, personalized campaigns across owned channels (push, in-app, and out-of-app), connecting them with the broader non-owned channels that shape the end-to-end member experience.
Generate data-driven hypotheses and run experiments to continuously optimize evergreen lifecycle campaigns and transactional communications, working with analytics to measure impact, socialize findings, and develop next steps toward bigger wins.
Develop and steward channel guidelines and governance, preserving the quality and integrity of our communications ecosystem.
Collaborate and build strong relationships with partners across Product, Product Marketing, Engineering, Analytics, Design, User Research, CRM, and more to develop and deliver on shared strategies for large cross-functional initiatives.
To thrive in this role, you have
4–6+ years of experience in lifecycle, growth, or related marketing, developing end-to-end campaigns from conceptualization to measurement.
A growth-oriented, business-first mindset—you think about revenue, LTV, and the full funnel, not just individual channels, and you can connect owned channels (push, in-app, out-of-app) with the broader member experience.
A proven track record of building segments and managing successful campaigns across multiple channels (email, push, SMS, in-app messaging).
Strong experimentation chops—comfortable with A/B testing and using results to inform what to scale next.
Strong analytical skills with experience in data-driven marketing and performance analysis.
The ability to work cross-functionally and collaborate with various stakeholders, exercising significant independent judgment.
Experience with key marketing platforms (Braze, Looker; AI tools a plus).
A strong self-starter mindset—adaptable and able to think critically to develop creative solutions with limited resources.

Paid Social & Paid Search
Own and scale DeepL's paid social programmes across LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, X and other emerging channels, tailoring strategy, audiences and creative to each platform's strengths.
Own and scale DeepL's paid search programmes across Google, Bing and other search engines, managing keyword strategy, bidding, ad copy and landing page alignment to maximise efficiency.
Define and manage channel-level budget allocation, shifting spend in response to real-time performance signals to hit CAC, pipeline and ARR targets.
Champion a culture of experimentation: design and run structured A/B tests across creative, audience, bidding strategy and landing experience, translating results into scalable playbooks.
Stay ahead of platform changes, betas and new ad formats across social and search, evaluating and piloting new channels where they offer efficient acquisition.

About Scopely
Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others.

Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami.

Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue.

Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.
Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ .

In this role, you won't just manage campaigns, you will own our search portfolio's evolution. You will be responsible for moving beyond traditional lead-gen metrics to implement advanced Value-Based Bidding (VBB) models that align search spend directly with downstream pipeline value.

Leveraging cutting-edge AI capabilities and robust statistical testing, you will maintain complete visibility over all in-market campaigns, ensuring every dollar spent is backed by data and optimized for maximum business impact.

Value-Based Strategy & Execution: Develop and execute comprehensive, AI-driven paid search strategies across Google Ads and Bing Ads. Lead the transition to and optimization of Value-Based Bidding (VBB) models to prioritize high-value pipeline and revenue over raw lead volume.
AI Integration & Innovation: Proactively leverage AI and machine learning capabilities within search platforms (e.g., Smart Bidding, Broad Match + Smart Bidding loops, AI-powered ad assets and campaign types) to scale performance, uncover hidden demand, and push our strategy past the industry curve.
Rigorous Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze structured A/B and multivariate tests (bidding, copy, landing pages). Champion a scientific approach, ensuring all test outcomes are measured for statistical significance before scaling.
Holistic In-Market Reporting: Maintain a unified, real-time view of all in-market campaigns. Deliver clear, executive-ready reporting that tracks performance across the entire funnel from click to closed-won revenue ensuring complete transparency of our search footprint.
Martech & Data Integration: Collaborate closely with Marketing Operations and Digital Analytics teams to ensure seamless integration with CRM platforms (Salesforce) and marketing automation (Marketo). Ensure accurate offline conversion tracking (OCT) to feed VBB algorithms high-quality feedback loops.
Audience & Competitive Intelligence: Conduct advanced keyword research, competitive benchmarking, and first/third-party audience segmentation to identify high-intent targeting opportunities.
Process Automation: Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to increase operational efficiency and scale our search program.
Account Hygiene & Automation: Actively audit account architecture to eliminate query bleeding and campaign cannibalization. Identify opportunities for workflow automation, scripting, and process improvement to scale our search program cleanly.

Education: BA or BS in Marketing, Business, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related analytical field.
Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing enterprise-level, full-funnel paid search campaigns, media planning, and advanced measurement.
Analytical Rigor: Exceptional analytical skills with a proven track record of using statistical significance models to validate test results and drive data-backed decisions.
VBB Expertise: Strong experience implementing and optimizing Value-Based Bidding (VBB) and offline conversion feedback loops (connecting CRM data back to ad platforms).
AI Literacy: Practical experience leveraging AI-driven search features, automated bidding algorithms, and predictive analytics tools to scale and optimize campaigns.
Martech Proficiency: Deep expertise in Google Ads, Bing Ads, Salesforce (CRM), Marketo/Eloqua (Marketing Automation), and advanced web analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GTM, or equivalent).
Project Management & Communication: Strong project management skills with the ability to translate complex, multi-layered data points into clear, concise, and actionable insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
B2B Context: Prior experience in B2B SaaS marketing is highly preferred.

INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Your story
You can work in a hybrid format where you're able to work on-site in our New York City office twice a week, and then choose where works best for you for the rest of the week.

Indipendente, è un pilastro del panorama mediatico svizzero, in quanto svolge un ruolo fondamentale nella promozione del dialogo aperto e nella diffusione di informazioni accurate.

Grazie a una vasta gamma di programmi radiofonici, televisivi e digitali, la RSI offre un servizio universale nel campo mediatico, raggiungendo e informando la popolazione in modo capillare.

Questa funzione è essenziale sia per la democrazia, sia per garantire che il pubblico svizzero sia costantemente aggiornato e informato, con una copertura che spazia dalla politica alla cultura, dall'economia all'intrattenimento, dallo sport all'educazione.

La RSI fornisce un quadro accurato della realtà svizzera su scala nazionale, linguistica e regionale, facilitando il dialogo e lo scambio tra le regioni linguistiche della Svizzera.**

We are hiring a Product Marketing Manager, New Products to lead that work. We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager to own Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy and execution - turning every update, feature drop, and seasonal moment into a campaign our players and community can’t stop talking about.
Sitting directly within the Hay Day game team, you will bridge product development, live ops, creative production, and community to turn product updates into major commercial and player-engagement wins.
What You'll Be Doing
Drive End-to-End GTM Strategy: Partner directly with product leads and game designers from early feature concepts to define positioning, f ormulate clear pre-launch hypotheses, and deliver high-impact marketing campaigns for all live updates, seasonal beats, and feature drops.
Lead Creative Campaign Delivery: Direct internal art directors, video producers, and external agencies to produce compelling trailers, visual assets, and marketing collateral that land with Hay Day’s core audience.
Explore Growth Channels with UA: Partner closely with UA and Performance Marketing teams to test and scale performance-driven channels including Connected TV (CTV), influencer integrations, creator platforms, and podcasts and more to expand game reach during major moments.
In-Game & Channel Execution: Operationalize player communications across in-game pop-ups, newsfeed beats, push notifications, App Store Optimization (ASO), and Web Shop / D2C channels.
Amplify via Community & Creators: Collaborate with Community Managers and content creators to design shareable launch beats that drive organic reach and creator content.
Measure & Iterate: Partner with analytics to validate campaign hypotheses, track launch performance, feature adoption, and player sentiment—using post-launch data to continuously sharpen future GTM playbooks.
What You Have
5+ years of Product Marketing experience in mobile gaming or live-service consumer products (casual, simulation, or puzzle experience is a big plus).
Proven GTM execution track record: Demonstrated experience taking live features and product updates from early concept to full public launch.
Sharp creative instincts: Strong aesthetic eye with the ability to give clear, actionable feedback on trailer cuts, visual assets, and player copy.
Performance channel & UA literacy: Solid understanding of performance marketing mechanics and experience evaluating multi-channel campaigns (UA, CTV, creator partnerships, podcasts).
Data & Hypothesis-Driven Mindset: Experience framing clear GTM hypotheses, defining success metrics pre-launch, and using post-campaign analytics to back up strategic decisions.
Cross-functional leadership: Exceptional project management skills with the ability to align developers, artists, and marketers without formal authority.
Collaborative mindset: Naturally builds trust, communicates openly, and thrives in cross-functional teams. Partner with analytics and support the insights team.
Where You'll Be
You are based in or willing to relocate to Helsinki, Finland. Alternatively, located in London with a willingness to travel.

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings , and killing lots of projects.
Hey, You Might Love It Here!
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture . But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
You Are Not Your Job Title ™
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
Relocation? Yes!
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
Not Sure if You Should Apply?
Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

Vos missions
Doctolib est le leader technologique et de l’IA en santé, avec l’ambition de transformer la santé en Europe. Alors que nous enrichissons notre suite de technologies et d’assistants IA couvrant l’ensemble des activités des soignants, nous voulons renforcer la perception de Doctolib auprès des professionnels de santé et affirmer notre rôle de partenaire technologique de référence.
En tant que B2B Brand Manager, vous transformez nos enjeux business, nos propositions de valeur et les besoins des soignants en positionnements distinctifs, campagnes créatives et plans d’activation à fort impact pour le marché français. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Social Media, Content, Product Marketing, Performance, Brand Design et Communication, ainsi qu’avec nos agences créatives et média.

s.h: Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à
s.t:
Positionnement stratégique : collaborer avec les Product Marketing Managers pour construire des positionnements différenciants pour nos produits et clusters, en traduisant les enjeux business et les besoins des soignants en récits de marque clairs et convaincants.
Stratégie d’activation : concevoir des plans d’activation intégrés en définissant les formats, canaux et contenus les plus pertinents selon les audiences, les objectifs et les étapes du funnel.
Campagnes 360° : imaginer et piloter des campagnes associant communication omnicanale, activations, événements, social media et formats digitaux, de la réflexion stratégique jusqu’au déploiement média.
Messaging & copywriting : transformer nos propositions de valeur en messages simples, distinctifs et mémorables, puis les adapter avec précision aux différents canaux et formats.
Excellence créative : rédiger des briefs exigeants, accompagner et challenger les agences, designers et partenaires de production afin de garantir un niveau d'exécution élevé sur chaque prise de parole.
Pilotage de projets : orchestrer les projets de bout en bout, en assurant la coordination des équipes, la maîtrise des budgets, le respect des calendriers et la qualité des livrables.
Mesure de la performance : définir les KPIs, consolider les résultats des campagnes et transformer les enseignements en recommandations concrètes pour les prochaines activations.
Amélioration continue : partager les insights de campagne avec les autres équipes afin d’affiner nos positionnements, nos messages et nos stratégies d’activation.

Avant de poursuivre votre lecture, si vous n’avez pas le profil exact décrit ci-dessous, mais que vous pensez que cette description de poste correspond à vos compétences et à vos aspirations, nous vous encourageons tout de même à postuler.
Vous pourrez être le/la prochain(e) membre de notre équipe si vous :
Vous parlez et écrivez couramment en français et en anglais.
Vous apportez au moins 6 ans d’expérience en Brand Management, idéalement dans une entreprise technologique, une scale-up ou un environnement B2B complexe.
Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux du brand building et savez les traduire en campagnes multicanales, activations, plans 360° et contenus sociaux.

Vous avez déjà piloté des campagnes intégrées, de la définition du positionnement jusqu’à la production et au déploiement média.
Vous possédez d’excellentes compétences en storytelling, messaging et copywriting, avec la capacité de rendre simples et mémorables des parcours produit et des propositions complexes.
Vous savez sélectionner les initiatives à plus fort impact et construire un mix de canaux adapté à chaque audience et objectif.
Vous êtes à l’aise avec le pilotage d’agences, de budgets, de productions et de projets transverses.
Vous savez utiliser les données et les résultats de campagne pour guider vos décisions et améliorer vos activations.
Vous maîtrisez déjà des outils IA appliqués au marketing et vous avez une forte curiosité pour leur potentiel, afin d’accélérer la production sans compromettre la qualité.

Customer Marketing is a new team at Teachable, an evolved scope from the previous Product Marketing team, that plays a critical role in connecting customer insight, product adoption, and business outcomes.

About Fundraise Up
We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe.

We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design. Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs.

With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver. About The Role Great products earn three different stories: the one that wins today's market, the one that opens tomorrow's, and the one that proves the architecture underneath both is right.

We're hiring three Product Marketing Managers for our product-facing team, reporting to the Director of Product Marketing (Product). This function owns positioning IP for what we build, while GTM Product Marketing activates it in market.

We're growing the team across three focus areas, and we'll match you to the one where your background and interests are the strongest fit.

Core Markets. Our established product lines and the verticals that generate the bulk of Fundraise Up 's ARR, including existing nonprofit segments and cause and cure organizations.

New Products. Capabilities we're extending into where we already have ICP fit but the capability is new to our platform, including peer-to-peer giving and in-person giving.

Platform & Core Products. The foundation everything else is built on: our core donation experience (checkout, campaign pages, donor portal, elements, donor documentation), the platform surface beneath it (APIs, integrations, developer experience, payment methods, localization, billing, dashboard, exports), and the experimentation engine that keeps it all improving.
Each track owns its own positioning IP and works the same way day to day, but the buyer, the maturity of the product, and the technical depth required differ. Let us know in your application which focus area is the strongest match for your background; we'll route accordingly during the interview process.

You are expected to be able to take a customer call about your product area without a solutions engineer in the room, at the depth of our public documentation. Our product is complex and deliberately opinionated.

Several of our differentiators are architectural, and you'll be expected to explain why the system works the way it does and turn that reasoning into a case customers find compelling. For Platform & Core Products, that extends to holding your own with technical evaluators in RevOps, IT, and data teams. Key Responsibilities
Run the Early Access Program for your focus area, coordinating with Sales and CS to identify and support customers and design partners on early releases.
Be an expert at capturing specific customer requirements from the field that Product Managers can incorporate into the roadmap.
Define and continuously evolve product positioning and messaging for your focus area, across relevant personas.
Transform complex product capabilities into clear, benefit-driven narratives, and build deep expertise in your product area.
Partner closely with Product, and with Engineering or Data Science where relevant, to determine product market fit, TAM, and opportunity cost of decisions.
Build and lead launch strategies for your focus area, in partnership with the Director.
Deliver content to GTM teams, including Demand Gen and RevOps, to drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact.
Own product-vs-product and roadmap-vs-roadmap competitive intelligence for your focus area.
Act as an ambassador for your focus area at conferences, in web content, and in customer-facing material.
Contribute to packaging, licensing, and bundling strategy for your focus area.
At Fundraise Up , AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve.

4+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, owning end-to-end product positioning and launches.
Product depth strong enough to take a customer call in your product area without a solutions engineer in the room.
Strong writing and storytelling ability paired with a strategic mind.
Comfortable working cross-functionally in fast-moving, high-growth environments, and confident leading conversations with Product, Sales, and Executive teams.
Solid grasp of marketing funnels, sales cycles, and customer journeys.
Deeply curious, data-driven, and motivated by purpose-driven work.
Able to travel internationally without restriction. Roughly 25% travel to the US and Europe for conferences, offsites, and industry events; you must be able to obtain the necessary authorizations.

Experience in nonprofit tech, fintech, or growth-stage startups.
For Core Markets: vertical marketing experience, especially nonprofit, faith, education, or health and cause-area expertise.
For New Products: 0 to 1 or new-capability product marketing experience, taking a product from early access through GA with direct early-customer development work, and comfort operating in ambiguity.
For Platform & Core Products: technical product marketing experience with platform, API, data, or ML/AI products, and and comfort getting up to speed quickly with a mature, market-leading platform.
You'll Thrive Here If You...
You would rather own the source of truth than wait for someone else to write it.
You can sit in a customer call and go deep on product with no safety net.
You see a stalled launch and start asking why, not whose job it was.
You treat AI as a default step in your workflow, not a tool you reach for occasionally.
You can turn a messy pile of field requirements into a roadmap-ready brief.
You would rather be right about the market than be the loudest voice in the room.
You take feedback from Sales, CS, and Product without getting territorial about your positioning.
You are comfortable being the one who says a launch is not ready, whether that's a mature product, a brand-new one, or a technical platform release.

Du gestaltest keine isolierten Maßnahmen, sondern ganzheitliche, umsatzgenerierende Ökosysteme für unsere Kunden.

s.h: Deine Spielwiese (Das machst du bei uns)
s.t:

Kanalübergreifendes Denken: Du arbeitest nicht in Silos. Du verstehst, wie die einzelnen Disziplinen (SEA, Paid Social, SEO/GEO, Content, CRO, Web Analytics) ineinandergreifen, und orchestrierst sie zu einer konsistenten Customer Journey – vom ersten Klick bis zur Conversion.

KI-Enablement: In unserem eigenen „AI Lab" identifizieren wir neue Use Cases. Du nutzt aktiv generative KI, um deine Workflows zu optimieren, Analysen und Konzepte zu iterieren und schneller zu besseren Entscheidungen zu kommen.

s.t:
Du hast ca. 1–3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Online Marketing – ob agentur- oder unternehmensseitig, ob generalistisch oder mit einem ersten Schwerpunkt (z. B. SEA, Paid Social, SEO oder Content).
Du hast Freude an der Kundenberatung und daran, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich aufzubereiten und zu präsentieren.
Du denkst in Kennzahlen: ROAS, CPA, Conversion Rate und Customer Lifetime Value sind für dich keine Fremdwörter. Analytisches Denken und Datenliebe stecken in deiner DNA.
Du bringst ein solides Grundverständnis über mehrere Marketingdisziplinen mit und willst verstehen, wie alles zusammenspielt – die Tiefe in einzelnen Kanälen baust du bei uns weiter aus.
Du bist kommunikationsstark, präsentierst gerne und hast Freude daran, Daten in verständliche Geschichten zu übersetzen – auf Deutsch und Englisch.
Du hast keine Angst vor Fehlern, denn du testest gerne hypothesenbasiert und lernst aus jedem Outcome.
Vor allem aber: Du hast Lust, dich weiterzuentwickeln und über dich hinauszuwachsen.

Echte Flexibilität: Deine Work-Life-Integration ist uns heilig. Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten.

Kultur & Wohlfühlfaktor: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, Teamevents und eine Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe. Und ja, Bürohunde sind bei uns nicht nur erlaubt, sondern absolut erwünscht!

Globale Perspektive: Durch die Zugehörigkeit zur Labelium Group arbeitest du an internationalen Projekten und hast Zugang zum Wissen von über 1.200 hochkarätigen Spezialisten weltweit.
Sicherheit: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sachbezüge, Essenszulagen, Mitarbeiterrabatte und gute Verkehrsanbindungen an unseren Standort in Frankfurt.
Klingt das nach deinem nächsten Karriereschritt?
Dann vergiss das klassische Anschreiben. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf, dein LinkedIn-Profil oder ein kurzes Video, in dem du uns erzählst, welches Marketingproblem du zuletzt gelöst hast – oder was dich am Beraten von Kunden am meisten reizt.
Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!
Bei uns zählt Vielfalt. Wir leben Inklusion, Respekt und Chancengleichheit.

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

s.h: Meet the team behind this journey

Put our customers on the world stage: Press interviews, webinars, keynotes and our Customer Advisory Board advocacy track. You recommend who speaks, agree the narrative with them in advance, and make each appearance count beyond the day itself..
Put a real customer in front of every buyer: Sales and Customer Success come to you when a deal needs a reference. You'll know which customers will speak, what they'll speak about, and how recently each was asked. New marquee stories the field, brand and events teams all pull from.
Named case studies covering every region, product lines and priority verticals
Reference requests resolved within the agreed turnaround time

Clear evidence that deals using a customer reference close at a better rate

We're on a mission
Every business grows through a CRM and a direct line to its customers. Healthcare, and pharmacy most of all, is the one place that never happened. It was too hard to build, too hard to distribute, and too hard to do compliantly. Customer data sits idle whilst running a community healthcare business continues to become structurally tighter.
We're on a mission to change that. We are the compliant data layer for community healthcare: the system that lets a pharmacy use the patient data it already holds to grow revenue and relationships, compliantly, on the clinical system it already runs.
This is already working. Pharmlogic is NHS-assured, integrated and lives in hundreds of pharmacies nationwide, and we've powered millions of patient communications.

You will run marketing across the board: brand and social, the website, copy across everything we put out, how we explain the product, and the campaigns that keep our pharmacy customers engaged. You own the channels and you set the standard for how Pharmlogic sounds and looks.
You report to the CEO and work closely with the founding team. This is a hands-on role for a generalist who can write, ship, and run several channels at once without waiting to be told. You are early, and the function is yours to shape.
The problems you'll own
Carrying the message: Take our vision, the why behind Pharmlogic, and make it land with the people we exist for. You translate what we believe into words that busy healthcare teams trust and can act on.
Communicating in a regulated space: Everything we put out can be read by healthcare professionals, other stakeholders and by patients. You write with the clarity, accuracy and care that demands, where compliant and compelling are the same standard, not a trade-off.
Our voice, everywhere: Own how Pharmlogic sounds across social, the website, campaigns and the product itself. One voice, centred on the vision, consistent wherever someone meets us.
From product to message: Turn what we build into messaging tailored to all stakeholders in a busy healthcare team that can be immediately understood. You make the complex simple without sacrificing value.
The customer journey: Own the communications that take a pharmacy from signed to thriving, engaged, getting full value, and staying, so the story we tell is the experience they have.
Knowing what works: Measure what you put out, double down on what performs, and feed what you learn back into how we market, sell and build.
Pharmlogic in the room: with the team at sector events, from the stand and the materials to the follow-up, so the people we meet in person get the same clear story as everyone else, and conversations turn into pipeline.
This could be for you if
You're an excellent communicator, above all. Writing is the craft at the centre of this job. You make complex things simple without making them shallow, you have taste, and it shows in everything you put out.
You've done lifecycle and product marketing in high-pace SaaS. You know how to take what a product does and turn it into a message people act on, and how to run the journey from signed customer to engaged advocate. That experience is what lets you move fast here from day one.
You thrive on the team's success. You get more from a customer win or a teammate's great launch than from your own byline. Small team, shared scoreboard.
You share the vision. You believe every healthcare business should be able to understand its customers and improve care for them while staying viable. If that sentence resonates rather than reads as marketing, this will feel like your work, not just a job.
You ship at startup pace. You put things out, learn, and go again, rather than polishing one thing for a month, and you do it without waiting for a brief.
Tooling fluency helps. Comfort with a CMS, email platforms, CRMs and basic design is a real advantage.
What you'll get
You'll be joining a fast-growing company and a small, sharp team focused on making community healthcare thrive.

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.
For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.
AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.
At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience.

But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.
We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.
Check out our principles to see how we work.

what makes you a great fit
You have 3+ years of experience in marketing , ideally in a B2B startup or scaleup.
You are an excellent writer: you can turn rough ideas into strong copy in both German and English.
You have taste: you know what high-quality content, design, and brand execution look like.

As part of the Demand Generation team and reporting to the Director, Regional Marketing, Strategic & Key Accounts, you will play a critical role in driving integrated demand generation, account engagement, and pipeline acceleration across Okta’s highest-value account segments. You will support both the Strategic Accounts Marketing team and the Key Accounts Marketing team by executing a multi-channel integrated framework that moves target accounts through the buyer journey.
This role requires a collaborative, energetic, creative, team-minded, and detail-oriented marketer. You will act as a force multiplier by establishing foundational mechanisms that the team operates upon, looking for continuous opportunities to optimize programs, operations, and reporting, and leveraging AI to streamline and automate workflows to consistently raise the bar for execution.

s.h: THE TILT: WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT
s.t:
We are seeking a proactive marketer who cares personally about team success while bringing energy, discipline, and creativity to daily execution:
Integrated Multi-Channel Framework: Supporting both Strategic and Key Accounts, you will help connect field events, direct mail, digital activations, and peer intelligence initiatives into cohesive, high-impact account journeys.
Foundational Mechanisms & Optimization: Rather than just executing single tactics, you will help build and refine operational mechanisms, playbooks, and reporting structures that optimize how our entire team operates.
AI-Driven Efficiency: You will actively embrace Generative AI and modern automation tools to optimize processes, accelerate content creation, and eliminate administrative friction to continually raise our bar.

Strategic Program Support & Campaign Optimization
Support campaign and program builds: Partner closely with regional marketing managers to assist in the setup, asset coordination, and logistics for field marketing events, executive dinners, VIP receptions, and targeted Account-Based Marketing (ABx) campaigns.
Optimize multi-channel nurtures & customer journeys: Work directly with Marketing Operations to analyze, update, and optimize email nurture sequences through a strategic account lens, unlocking continuous improvements in account engagement and conversion.
Maintain visibility & alignment across team initiatives: Stay deeply plugged into all active regional campaigns across Strategic and Key Accounts to ensure central communication mechanisms, field newsletters, and team playbooks remain accurate and continuously updated.
Serve as key data & operational problem solver: Act as the primary point of contact for troubleshooting data discrepancies, lead routing issues, and campaign tracking errors across Salesforce and Tableau to preserve reporting integrity.
Marketing Operations, Event Logistics & Mechanisms
Manage comprehensive event logistics and vendor relations , encompassing venue sourcing, webinar/platform setup, swag replenishment, and Purchase Order (PO) creation.
Instill and maintain foundational team mechanisms , tracking systems, and operational templates to drive execution rigor, consistency, and business continuity across the Strategic and Key Account segments.
Leverage AI tools and automated workflows to streamline daily operations, optimize reporting, and automate repetitive tasks across assigned programs.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Enablement
Foster strong cross-functional partnerships across Strategic & Key Accounts: Collaborate closely with Regional Marketing Managers (RMMs), Sales, SDRs, Campaigns, Strategic Events, and Product Marketing to align on target account priorities, drive shared revenue outcomes, and systematically capture and share best practices across the broader marketing team.
Lead field sales communication efforts by owning and delivering weekly strategic field marketing newsletters and campaign alerts, positioning marketing campaigns as actionable pipeline levers.
Manage centralized tools and playbooks , such as "Go-To Guides" and Regional Decks, to increase field visibility, standardize marketing plays, and drive field adoption.
Lead Management & Automated Workflows
Oversee campaign enablement and lead management by building localized registration pages (e.g., Splash), crafting urgency-driven invite copy, and establishing white-glove post-event lead routing.
Architect automated follow-up sequences that alert Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to engage prospects, providing them with templated messaging, conversation starters, and account intelligence to accelerate outreach.
Data Analytics, Reporting & Program Optimization
Develop and standardize actionable reporting frameworks for event registration, attendance tracking, and target account intent using Salesforce, 6sense, and marketing analytics platforms.
Empower sales and marketing teams with data-driven insights , leveraging analytics to pivot strategies in real time, evaluate program ROI, and optimize regional targeting strategies.

2+ years of professional B2B tech marketing experience (field marketing, demand generation, or account-based marketing preferred).
Bachelor’s Degree ; Marketing, Communications, or Business preferred.
Experience with marketing and sales technology , including CRM (Salesforce) and Marketing Automation platforms (e.g., Marketo, Eloqua).
Familiarity with ABM platforms and modern tools (e.g., 6sense, Demandbase), event management software (e.g., Splash, Zoom), and project management applications (e.g., Asana).
Familiarity with Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to accelerate content creation, automate workflows, and analyze program performance.
Strong analytical abilities with a passion for working with data, analyzing outcomes, and scoping out key insights to establish continuous optimization.
Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation communication skills with a keen attention to detail.
Self-starter mindset who excels at multitasking, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and demonstrates a positive, team-first growth mindset.

Scopely is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team, helping shape how one of mobile gaming's deepest, most enduring, and most community-driven live-service experiences is understood, experienced, and adopted by millions of players worldwide.
This role sits at the intersection of Product, Live Operations, Marketing, Community, Campaigns, and Player Experience. You will partner closely with Product teams to translate complex systems, features, and roadmap initiatives into compelling player value, ensuring every launch delivers a clear narrative, coordinated execution, and an exceptional player experience.
Product Marketing serves as the connective tissue across the player-facing organization. While Product defines what we build, Community builds trust, Campaign Marketing activates audiences, and Player Experience supports players, Product Marketing ensures every team is aligned around a shared strategy, consistent messaging, and a coordinated go-to-market plan.
Success in this role requires equal parts strategic thinking and hands-on execution. You'll develop positioning, own go-to-market strategy, create messaging frameworks, build launch materials, guide creative development, and coordinate cross-functional teams to bring new features, seasonal content, technical improvements, and major Star Trek moments to life.
Star Trek Fleet Command is one of the most sophisticated strategy games in mobile. The ideal candidate enjoys simplifying complexity, thrives in cross-functional environments, and is energized by turning ambitious product ideas into experiences that players understand, value, and remember.

Own the Player-Facing Narrative
Own the player-facing narrative for Star Trek Fleet Command , translating product strategy into clear, compelling experiences that help players understand not just what we're building, but why it matters
Champion the player perspective throughout the product development lifecycle, ensuring features, systems, and content are positioned in ways that resonate with our diverse player base
Establish messaging frameworks that create consistency across every player-facing touchpoint, from launch campaigns and CRM to roadmap communications and in-game messaging
Translate Product Strategy into Player Value
Partner with Product, Design, Economy, Live Operations, Analytics, and Creative teams throughout feature development
Translate complex gameplay systems, progression mechanics, monetization initiatives, technical improvements, and roadmap priorities into compelling player-facing narratives
Develop positioning, messaging, and value propositions for new features, seasonal content, technical improvements, and franchise initiatives
Ensure every major release tells a clear story that connects product innovation with meaningful player outcomes
Lead Go-to-Market Strategy
Own integrated go-to-market strategies for major game features, seasonal arcs, technical improvements, and franchise partnerships
Build launch plans that align messaging, timing, audiences, business objectives, and player education across every player-facing channel
Define player segmentation and messaging strategies that support players throughout their lifecycle and progression journey
Establish launch objectives and success criteria in partnership with Product, Marketing, and Analytics teams
Drive Cross-Functional Launch Readiness
Serve as the central marketing partner connecting Product, Community, Campaign Marketing, CRM, Creative, Analytics, Player Experience, Publishing, and external partners
Coordinate launch readiness across all player-facing functions, ensuring messaging, creative assets, support documentation, operational plans, and partner approvals are complete before release
Facilitate launch planning, milestone reviews, and cross-functional communication to proactively identify risks and remove blockers
Partner with Community and Player Experience to ensure player communications, support readiness, and recovery messaging remain aligned throughout launches and live incidents
Own Product Messaging & Creative Stewardship
Create creative briefs, messaging frameworks, presentations, launch documentation, executive materials, and marketing guidance that enable successful execution across the organization
Review and approve marketing assets to ensure consistency across channels and alignment with product strategy, brand standards, and franchise guidelines
Partner with Creative teams to develop high-quality marketing materials that communicate player value while maintaining franchise authenticity
Manage approvals and asset delivery with Paramount and other external partners
Measure Product Adoption & Optimize Performance
Monitor feature adoption, player engagement, sentiment, campaign performance, and commercial outcomes following launches
Partner with Analytics, Community, and Player Experience to identify player friction, adoption barriers, and opportunities for optimization
Translate quantitative and qualitative player insights into actionable recommendations for future launches and product improvements
Continuously refine positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategies through experimentation, testing, and post-launch analysis
Lead the Product Marketing Function
Lead and evolve the Product Marketing discipline for Star Trek Fleet Command, continuously improving launch quality, planning processes, and organizational effectiveness
Manage the Campaign Manager, providing coaching, prioritization, and strategic direction across day-to-day marketing execution
Own the Product Marketing operating cadence, including roadmap reviews, launch planning, partner coordination, and cross-functional alignment
Build trusted relationships across Product, Marketing, Creative, Publishing, Licensing, and executive leadership to improve decision-making and execution
Establish scalable frameworks, documentation, and best practices that strengthen Product Marketing's impact across the organization

Strategic, curious, and relentlessly player-focused
Comfortable operating at the intersection of product strategy, marketing, and player experience
Motivated by turning complex systems into simple, compelling stories that players understand and value
Collaborative by nature, bringing diverse teams together around a shared vision and common goals
Equally confident leading strategic discussions with executives and producing hands-on deliverables that move launches forward
Data-informed but never data-limited, combining analytics with player empathy to make sound decisions
Adaptable in fast-moving environments where priorities evolve and every launch presents new opportunities to learn
Passionate about live-service games and excited by the challenge of helping millions of players discover, understand, and engage with new experiences
What You've Done
Translated complex products into compelling player stories, developing positioning and go-to-market strategies that improved player understanding, feature adoption, engagement, and commercial performance

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

This is a partner marketing role that demands product marketing craft. You'll be the single-threaded owner of how every Claude launch lands on partner marketing surfaces. We reach many of our most important customers through our partners.

When we ship a new model or capability, it doesn't just launch on first-party surfaces; it launches across our growing partner ecosystem, each with their own product pages, blogs, seller enablement, and go-to-market motions. Our product release cadence has accelerated, and we're looking for someone to own that translation end-to-end.
Model and capabilities launches are the core of the job and the majority of the work. The rest is solution launches — the joint and co-built solutions that land on partner surfaces alongside our models. The two halves reinforce each other. Model launches create the moment; solution launches translate what’s possible for the sellers and customers on the other side.
You'll be the first dedicated owner of launch readiness across our partner surfaces, consolidating work currently spread across several people and creating a center of excellence for how we do this work.

This role centralizes launch coordination for our partners — briefing partner teams under confidentiality, shaping how our positioning shows up on their surfaces, and orchestrating execution cross functionally. You'll be the person who knows exactly what's available on which surface, how we're messaging it, and how it all fits together.

You will use this knowledge to ensure our launches are positioned for the highest impact and amplification across our partners.
The job is roughly half launch execution and half building. On the execution side, you'll run the launch playbook. On the building side, you'll define what we haven't had the bandwidth to create yet. You'll set the standard for how Anthropic shows up on partner surfaces and hold the rest of the company to it, without anyone involved reporting to you.
Anthropic reaches a substantial share of its customer base through partner surfaces, and the ecosystem is still growing. How Claude shows up on the platforms where enterprises actually buy AI is largely unwritten. This is the role that writes it.

Own partner launch readiness end-to-end, serving as the directly responsible individual for every model, feature, and solution launch across the partner ecosystem — from the first briefing through launch-day go-live and reach reporting
Define the operating model for partner launches: set the standard for what readiness means, decide what's durable enough to share and when, and own the trade-offs when timelines and partner needs conflict
Equip partner sellers and solution architects to position Claude for a customer workload without escalating to us — segment-specific enablement, technical content, and the materials their field actually reaches for
Translate Anthropic positioning for partner surfaces, taking source messaging from Product Marketing and creating partner-specific versions that account for what's available where, what each partner needs to hear, and how the narrative lands on their platform
Own the go-to-market motion for joint and co-built solutions on partner surfaces — position what a partner and Anthropic have built together, make the value legible to that partner's sellers and customers, and land it across the channels where their buyers look
Work with Partnerships, Product, and partner-side teams to shape solutions into launchable moments, and make the call on which are worth a launch at all
Run launch execution – Manage cross-functional review cycles, support partner launch preparedness, compile post-launch reporting
Build post-launch momentum through partner webinars, technical content pipelines, and campaigns that keep partners selling after launch-day
Represent the partner perspective internally — surface Anthropic-direct launches that will affect partner relationships, flag partner-experience issues in product decisions, and make sure partner considerations arrive early rather than as a fire drill
Turn informal knowledge into documented, repeatable process as our release cadence and partner portfolio grow, and build the function so it scales beyond any one person

The Opportunity
ServiceNow is transforming how enterprises orchestrate their business. Partners are central to this mission—they activate demand, deliver solutions, and extend our platform. As Senior Partner Marketing Manager for APAC, you'll own the strategy and execution of partner-led go-to-market across the region, leading a transformation in how we activate, enable, and scale partner channels.
This is a strategic role reporting directly to the Director of APAC Partner Marketing. You'll drive partner demand generation, manage our Marketing Development Funds (MDF) program at scale, and design the partner experience & events strategy & playbooks that fuel pipeline growth across APAC. You'll work with C&I partners, managed service providers, resellers, hyperscalers, and technology partners—each with distinct GTM requirements and commercial models.
What You'll Own
Partner-Led Demand Engine
Design and execute partner-led demand generation strategy for APAC. This includes demand gen campaign architecture, partner co-marketing playbooks, lead distribution, and sales-to-partner handoff processes. You'll own targets for partner-influenced pipeline and direct metrics for partner activation, lead generation, and deal registration and will be an influential member of the APAC Partner-Led business Leadership team.
Regional Partner Experience & Events Strategy and Execution
Owns APAC-wide partner experience and events strategy, AI Summits, World Forum partner sessions, and the regional Partner Summits. Driving demand generation campaigns, sponsor management, and partner engagement programs that build advocacy and pipeline across the region.
Marketing Development Funds (MDF) Program
Manage the APAC MDF budget as a strategic lever for partner activation. You'll enable the APAC partner marketing managers and work with the Global MDF program team to drive partner participation, approve and audit co-marketing campaigns, and measure ROI against partner pipeline contribution. Strong partners will see MDF as an investment vehicle for growth, not a compliance requirement.
We're investing heavily in partner channels as the primary engine for customer acquisition and success. Partner-led demand is growing 139% year-over-year, and APAC is our highest-growth region. You'll have real budget, real responsibility, and a platform to shape how ServiceNow scales through partners globally.
We value operators who think clearly, move fast, and lead with data. You'll work with a talented partner marketing team, influential stakeholders, and partners who are serious about their ServiceNow practice.

Experience
10+ years in partner marketing, channel marketing, or go-to-market strategy at B2B SaaS or enterprise software companies. You've managed or influenced integrated marketing demand generation at scale directly as well as with partners. You have a strong event management experience, managed agencies and large budgets & ROI. Familiarity with MDF program management, and partner co-marketing is strongly preferred. Experience in APAC markets is valuable.
Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry.
Skills & Mindset
You're a strategist who gets into execution. You design campaigns, manage vendors, audit spend, and close the loop on metrics. You can operate in ambiguity, set your own priorities, and hold partners (and yourself) accountable. You're curious about partner business models and can translate between partner incentives and ServiceNow objectives. You communicate with clarity and conviction.
Partner Acumen
You understand that partners are businesses with their own economics. You can think like a partner—what drives their growth, how they compete, what they need to succeed. You've built relationships with partners at the executive level and can navigate commercial negotiations.
Analytics Orientation
You care about pipeline, influence, and ROI. You can build a business case, track campaign performance, and course-correct based on data. Proficiency with marketing automation, analytics, and CRM systems is expected.

For years, account-based marketing at Fresh Prints has been built around campaigns. We identify an opportunity, launch a program, measure the results, and rebuild the approach the following year. That is no longer enough.
Our highest-value accounts should not be managed as a series of campaigns. They need a long-term growth strategy: a clear view of which accounts deserve disproportionate investment, what will materially change their value, and how Fresh Prints should serve, retain, and expand them over time. Your job will be to build that strategy.
You will bring together customer insights, data, segmentation, and operational execution to determine where the biggest account growth opportunities exist and what the business must do to capture them. The goal is to build an account-growth system that becomes more intelligent, more effective, and more valuable with every cycle.
There is no established function to inherit and no finished playbook to manage. You will define what account-based marketing should mean for Fresh Prints, build the operating model behind it, and drive the business to execute against it across Marketing, Sales, Creative, Data, and Operations.
We are not looking for someone who will optimize the existing approach at the margins. We are looking for someone who will question its assumptions, identify the few bets that could materially change account value, and take responsibility for turning those bets into results.

Defining how Fresh Prints grows and retains its most valuable accounts at the company level, not simply running better campaigns.
Building an account strategy that continues to work as chapters, decision-makers, relationships, and buying cycles change.
Identifying the few highest-leverage bets that could materially increase account value, then focusing the business around them.
Turning strategy into execution through direct ownership, cross-functional influence, and systems that scale.
Shaping how Marketing, Sales, Operations, and account-facing teams approach retention, expansion, and long-term account development.
Building account growth into a durable business capability, not an initiative that resets every campaign cycle.
What You'll Own
Company-Level Account Strategy
Build the long-term growth strategy for Fresh Prints’ highest-value accounts.
Define how the business should identify, segment, prioritise, invest in, retain, and expand those accounts over time.
Develop a strategy that remains effective even as student leaders, decision-makers, buying committees, and internal account owners change.
Use customer insight, account data, and commercial judgment to identify the few opportunities that could materially change account value across the business.
Shape decisions across sales motions, customer experience, and account coverage when those decisions are necessary to unlock growth.
Turning Strategy Into Results
Take responsibility for moving the strategy from an idea into how the company actually operates.
This is not a role that ends with recommendations, presentations, or campaign briefs. You will stay close enough to execution to ensure the strategy produces measurable results.
Use AI, automation, process, and disciplined prioritisation to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.
Partner with Sales, BDM, Campus Manager leadership, Marketing, Creative, Data, and Operations to translate the strategy into clear actions, ownership, and operating rhythms.
Build the systems, decision rules, and playbooks that allow teams to execute the strategy correctly without depending on you to manage every action.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Represent account growth and retention in executive-level conversations.
Bring a clear, evidence-backed point of view on where the company should place its bets, what it should stop doing, and what needs to change.
Build the commercial case and organisational support required to secure resources, change priorities, and influence how teams operate.
Raise the quality of thinking and execution across teams you do not formally manage through clarity, judgment, and credibility.
Measure success through changes in retention, expansion, and account value, not simply through campaign delivery or short-term engagement metrics.

You think in systems, not isolated campaigns, and build strategies that outlast any individual relationship or decision-maker.
You have created a meaningful step-change in performance before, not only improved an established playbook at the margins.
You are comfortable entering an ambiguous problem, forming a strong point of view, and creating the path forward without precedent.
You can move from customer insight and data to clear strategic choices, then stay close enough to execution to make those choices real.
You know how to raise the performance of teams you do not manage through strong judgment, clear systems, and influence rather than formal authority.
You have the credibility to challenge assumptions, influence senior leaders, and push the business toward harder but higher-value decisions.
You take retention and expansion as seriously as acquisition and see all three as part of the same account-growth system.

A track record of delivering significant, measurable improvements in account growth, retention, expansion, or customer value.
Evidence of building a new strategy, capability, or operating model rather than only managing an established function.
Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect customer insight, data, and business economics.
Experience driving meaningful outcomes across teams without relying on formal authority.
Strong executive communication, including presenting recommendations, challenging assumptions, and securing senior-level buy-in.
Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction without precedent, and being accountable for results without an established playbook.

We're redefining how the world creates and designs.

100M+ social impressions

No funding. No shortcuts. Just a sharp, driven team building one of the strongest GenAI products in the world, and we're just getting started.

We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition for our web product.
This is a web-first role. You will own the funnel from ad impression to paid subscription, across Meta, TikTok and Google, with real budget behind it from day one. ImagineArt is a consumer subscription product, so the numbers that matter to you are CAC, payback window and trial to paid conversion, not lead volume or MQLs.
The honest constraint in this role is creative. In consumer AI, paid social rewards volume and iteration speed more than clever targeting, and you will be shipping a lot of creative against a product that generates images and video. That is an unusual advantage and we want someone who will actually use it.

Own paid acquisition on the web
Own strategy and daily execution across Meta, TikTok and Google
Manage budget at real scale, with responsibility for CAC and payback targets
Build and scale web to web and web to app funnels, including paywall and checkout testing
Make the funnel convert
Run structured CRO on landing pages, paywalls, pricing and onboarding
Own trial to paid conversion alongside product and growth
Build the measurement setup you need, from attribution through to incrementality testing
Ship creative at volume
Work with designers, editors and creators to keep a constant flow of new ad concepts
Build a testing cadence where losing creative is killed fast and winners are scaled
Use ImagineArt itself, and AI tooling generally, to compress the time from idea to live ad
Own the numbers
Report on spend, CAC, payback, LTV and contribution margin honestly, including what is not working
Forecast what more budget would actually buy
Decide where the next dollar goes

Required
You have personally managed $1M+ USD in paid media. Not an agency aggregate across many clients, not a team total. Budget you owned.
Direct experience with consumer subscription economics: CAC, payback window, trial to paid
Hands-on ownership of Meta, TikTok or Google at meaningful daily spend
Web funnel experience. You have built and optimised web checkout or paywall flows, not only app store installs.
You can show your own numbers and explain what you would do differently

Experience in consumer AI, creative tools, or another category where creative volume is the bottleneck
AI tooling already inside your own workflow, not just as a product you market
Experience scaling in more than one market or language
Comfort working across time zones with a distributed team
Not a fit if

s.h: Your experience is mainly B2B lead generation or brand marketing

You need a large existing team and established processes to be effective

We will ask you one question early, so you may as well know it now: what is the largest monthly budget you personally owned, on a single account, and what was the payback window. Bring real numbers. We would much rather hear about a channel that stopped working and what you did about it than a highlight reel.

Profitable, no outside funding, so the growth is real and so is the budget
A product that makes the creative your ads depend on
Direct access to founders and genuine ownership of the number

A full stack PMM – You love evolving existing and developing new products from idea to market, creating a compelling story, packaging, and driving the GTM from start to finish.

Own product marketing for top priority features from positioning and messaging through packaging, launch, and early commercialization.

About Cytix
Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on. That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.
We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.
Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.
Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.
See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.
Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.
Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.
Sound like you on a normal working day? We'd love to meet you.

This is a senior, founding-leader hire at L7. We're looking for someone strategy-strong who can autonomously own a regional function end to end — set the strategy, build the operating system, carry the number, and represent marketing credibly to regional sales leadership and to global marketing leadership at the same time. Not a program manager who executes a plan set elsewhere.
The essential tension to screen for: this person needs the seniority and judgment to lead an org, and the willingness to be a team of one for a while. Regional expansion is planned but the timing isn't fixed, which means for some meaningful period they are writing the doc, running the roundtable, and negotiating with the agency themselves. Scrappy, low-ego, and hands-on — but senior enough to see the whole picture without the support systems a mature regional marketing org would provide.
Regional judgment matters more here than in most field marketing roles. One person cannot serve five sub-regions equally, so the job is fundamentally about sequencing: which markets get real first-party investment, which get partner-led coverage, and which wait. They need to make those calls, defend them to sales leaders in each market, and revisit them as signal comes in.
Partner fluency is not a nice-to-have in this region — it's the primary distribution mechanism. Someone who has only run first-party programs will find the leverage model unfamiliar.
What a successful candidate looks like: a leader who landed in a new region with nothing, picked the right two markets to prove out, used partner and agency capacity to punch well above their headcount, and can point to the pipeline, the operating system, and the team plan they left behind.

Pressure-test appetite for building infrastructure from scratch rather than operating within an existing system, and for the period before they have a team.
